+"""Shared evidence-side contracts: ``RunSpec``, ``EvidenceItem``, ``EvidencePack``.
+
+# Implements: FR-01, INV-02
+
+Type-layer only. These models fix the SHAPE the evidence module (A) produces and
+its consumers read; they do NOT filter by time, generate ids, dedupe, or compare
+digests at pack time. Those behaviours belong to ``egta.evidence`` (A):
+
+- ``evidence_id`` is generated by the evidence module from the run id + case local
+  id; these types store the id they are given and never mint one.
+- the UTC date filter (strictly-earlier admitted / same-date excluded / exact
+  timestamp equality admitted) is A's; these types only carry its outcomes.
+- ``content_hash`` is NOT cross-validated against ``excerpt`` here, so a tampered
+  item is constructible; the evidence module recomputes and reports
+  ``INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`` at pack time.
+
+The shared ``ReasonCode`` is owned by the contracts package's events module; this
+module imports it rather than defining a second enum.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator
+
+from egta.contracts.events import ReasonCode
+
+_HASH_PATTERN = r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
+_DATE_ONLY = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$")
+
+
+class Availability(StrEnum):
+    """Admission state of an evidence item.
+
+    Distinct from ``ReasonCode``: ``availability`` is the state, ``reason_code`` is
+    the cause. They are independent and neither substitutes for the other.
+    """
+
+    AVAILABLE = "available"
+    STALE = "stale"
+    UNREACHABLE = "unreachable"
+    UNAVAILABLE = "unavailable"
+
+
+def _normalize_time(value: Any) -> Any:
+    """Normalize an evidence timestamp for ``published_at`` / ``fetched_at``.
+
+    A bare ``YYYY-MM-DD`` is kept as a ``date`` so day precision survives to the
+    public JSON form (no invented time or offset). Any other string is parsed as a
+    datetime; a timezone-aware value is converted to UTC, and a naive one is kept
+    as given. The contract frozen for these types does not require rejecting a naive
+    evidence timestamp, so this function does not reject one here: deciding whether
+    an evidence time is admissible (including a naive or malformed value) is A's
+    ``egta.evidence`` time-policy responsibility, not this type's.
+    """
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        if _DATE_ONLY.fullmatch(value):
+            return date.fromisoformat(value)
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        return parsed.astimezone(UTC) if parsed.tzinfo is not None else parsed
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        return value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo is not None else value
+    return value
+
+
+class RunSpec(BaseModel):
+    """Run definition shared by every module (plan §5.1).
+
+    ``as_of`` is the analysis instant: a timezone-aware UTC datetime. A bare date
+    or a naive timestamp is rejected (evidence may be date-only; ``as_of`` may not).
+    """
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)
+
+    schema_version: str
+    run_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    ticker: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    as_of: datetime
+    mode: str
+    model_config_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH_PATTERN)
+    prompt_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH_PATTERN)
+    policy_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH_PATTERN)
+    snapshot_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    limits: dict[str, Any]
+
+    @field_validator("as_of", mode="before")
+    @classmethod
+    def _require_aware_instant(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
+        # Reject a bare date string outright: as_of must be an instant.
+        if isinstance(value, str) and _DATE_ONLY.fullmatch(value):
+            raise ValueError("as_of must be a timezone-aware datetime, not a bare date")
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("as_of")
+    @classmethod
+    def _as_of_aware_utc(cls, value: datetime) -> datetime:
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("as_of must be timezone-aware (UTC)")
+        return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+class EvidenceItem(BaseModel):
+    """One admitted or excluded evidence item (plan §5.1).
+
+    ``availability`` is required and enumerated. ``reason_code`` and
+    ``conflict_group`` default to ``None``. ``published_at`` accepts a date-only
+    value (kept as a date) or a full timestamp.
+    """
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)
+
+    evidence_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    source_uri: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    published_at: date | datetime
+    fetched_at: date | datetime
+    content_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH_PATTERN)
+    excerpt: str
+    availability: Availability
+    trust_label: str
+    reason_code: ReasonCode | None = None
+    conflict_group: str | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("published_at", "fetched_at", mode="before")
+    @classmethod
+    def _keep_day_precision(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
+        return _normalize_time(value)
+
+
+class ExcludedItem(BaseModel):
+    """A pack exclusion: exactly the three agreed fields.
+
+    Not an ``EvidenceItem``: no ``published_at`` and no full ``evidence_id``.
+    ``case_local_id == "provider"`` marks a provider-level failure. Provider error
+    detail is recorded by the evidence module in the audit payload, not here.
+    """
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    case_local_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    availability: Availability
+    reason_code: ReasonCode
+
+
+class EvidencePack(BaseModel):
+    """The evidence module's output for one run (plan §5.1).
+
+    ``excluded_items`` is required (an explicit empty list is valid; omitting it
+    fails). ``cutoff`` is the same instant as the run/fixture ``as_of``.
+    ``pack_hash`` is carried as supplied; its algorithm is not frozen here.
+    """
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", allow_inf_nan=False)
+
+    run_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    snapshot_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    items: list[EvidenceItem]
+    excluded_items: list[ExcludedItem]
+    cutoff: datetime
+    pack_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH_PATTERN)
+
+    @field_validator("cutoff")
+    @classmethod
+    def _cutoff_aware_utc(cls, value: datetime) -> datetime:
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("cutoff must be timezone-aware (UTC)")
+        return value.astimezone(UTC)

+"""ExperimentManifest contract (implements the approved FR-05 spec).
+
+# Implements: FR-05, NFR-08, NFR-09
+
+Frozen manifest with B's confirmed decisions: four variants B0-B3 (all
+non-empty), typed ``metrics_rubric`` (``MetricDef``), an independent
+``quality_rubric`` (``QualityRubric``), and ``code_hash`` / ``policy_hash`` /
+``manifest_hash``. ``compute_manifest_hash`` is the canonical SHA-256 over the
+manifest excluding ``manifest_hash`` (see docs/req/contracts-summary.md §3).
+
+Construction does not require ``manifest_hash == compute_manifest_hash`` (the
+hash is verified by the comparison layer against the recorded value); we provide
+the canonical computation and ``recompute_hash()``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator
+
+_HASH64 = r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
+_CODE = r"^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$"
+REQUIRED_VARIANTS = ("B0", "B1", "B2", "B3")
+
+
+class MetricDef(BaseModel):
+    """One rubric metric: metric name + comparison + verification metadata."""
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    metric: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    operator: Literal["eq", "lte", "gte", "lt", "gt"]
+    threshold: float
+    verification: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    source: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    aggregation: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    unit: str = Field(min_length=1)
+
+
+class QualityRubric(BaseModel):
+    """Independent quality-judging policy (three levels, double-blind, etc.)."""
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    levels: list[str] = Field(min_length=3)
+    double_blind: bool
+    third_party_adjudication: bool
+    llm_judge_assist: bool
+
+
+def compute_manifest_hash(manifest: ExperimentManifest) -> str:
+    """Canonical SHA-256 over the manifest excluding ``manifest_hash``."""
+    data = manifest.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"manifest_hash"})
+    canonical = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+class ExperimentManifest(BaseModel):
+    """Frozen inputs for one controlled comparison across variants."""
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True, validate_assignment=True)
+
+    manifest_id: str
+    created_at: datetime
+    target_snapshot_id: str
+    model_config_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH64)
+    prompt_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH64)
+    code_hash: str = Field(pattern=_CODE)
+    policy_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH64)
+    manifest_hash: str = Field(pattern=_HASH64)
+    variants: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
+    metrics_rubric: dict[str, MetricDef]
+    quality_rubric: QualityRubric
+
+    @field_validator("created_at")
+    @classmethod
+    def _require_tz_aware(cls, value: datetime) -> datetime:
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("created_at must be timezone-aware (UTC)")
+        return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _require_variants(self) -> ExperimentManifest:
+        for name in REQUIRED_VARIANTS:
+            if name not in self.variants:
+                raise ValueError(f"manifest is missing required variant: {name}")
+            if not self.variants[name]:
+                raise ValueError(f"variant {name} must have a non-empty configuration")
+        for name in self.variants:
+            if name not in REQUIRED_VARIANTS:
+                raise ValueError(f"unknown variant: {name}")
+        if not self.metrics_rubric:
+            raise ValueError("metrics_rubric must be a non-empty mapping")
+        return self
+
+    def recompute_hash(self) -> str:
+        """Return this manifest's canonical hash (excluding ``manifest_hash``)."""
+        return compute_manifest_hash(self)

+"""Deterministic metrics aggregation with failure-sample accounting (E2).
+
+# Implements: FR-05, NFR-09
+
+Aggregates ``EvaluationResult``s against a typed rubric (``dict[str, MetricDef]``,
+validated via ``TypeAdapter`` — a raw/illegal rubric is rejected). Applies each
+``MetricDef.operator``/``threshold`` to the observed per-result metric values.
+Failure-sample accounting follows ``docs/code-governance/verification-constraints.md``:
+the success denominator is ``|OK| + |HOLD|`` (``COMPLETE``); BLOCKED / INCOMPLETE /
+REVIEW / FAILED are excluded from the denominator but **reported** (never deleted).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import TypeAdapter
+
+from egta.contracts.evaluation import CompletionStatus, EvaluationResult
+from egta.contracts.manifest import MetricDef
+
+_METRIC_OPERATORS = {
+    "eq": lambda v, t: v == t,
+    "lte": lambda v, t: v <= t,
+    "gte": lambda v, t: v >= t,
+    "lt": lambda v, t: v < t,
+    "gt": lambda v, t: v > t,
+}
+
+_EXCLUDED = (
+    CompletionStatus.BLOCKED,
+    CompletionStatus.INCOMPLETE,
+    CompletionStatus.REVIEW,
+    CompletionStatus.FAILED,
+)
+
+
+def aggregate(
+    results: list[EvaluationResult], rubric: dict[str, MetricDef]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Deterministic aggregate of results under a typed rubric."""
+    rubric = TypeAdapter(dict[str, MetricDef]).validate_python(rubric)
+
+    counts: dict[str, int] = {status.value: 0 for status in CompletionStatus}
+    for result in results:
+        counts[result.completion_status.value] += 1
+
+    denominator = counts[CompletionStatus.COMPLETE.value]
+    excluded = sum(counts[status.value] for status in _EXCLUDED)
+
+    per_metric: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
+    for name, definition in rubric.items():
+        passed = failed = 0
+        for result in results:
+            if result.completion_status is not CompletionStatus.COMPLETE:
+                continue
+            if name not in result.metrics:
+                continue
+            ok = _METRIC_OPERATORS[definition.operator](
+                result.metrics[name], definition.threshold
+            )
+            if ok:
+                passed += 1
+            else:
+                failed += 1
+        per_metric[name] = {"passed": passed, "failed": failed}
+
+    return {
+        "denominator": denominator,
+        "excluded": excluded,
+        "counts": counts,
+        "per_metric": per_metric,
+    }

+"""Offline replay orchestration for a run's event log (E2).
+
+# Implements: FR-05, NFR-08
+
+Thin wrapper over :func:`egta.contracts.evaluation.replay_events` (dedupe-first,
+``(run_id, sequence)`` sort, chain verify + anchor) with optional run scoping.
+Fully offline: reads only the event payloads; never calls a model or network.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from egta.contracts.evaluation import ReplayState, replay_events
+from egta.contracts.events import RunEvent
+
+
+def replay_run(
+    events: list[RunEvent], *, run_id: str | None = None, anchor: str | None = None
+) -> ReplayState:
+    """Reconstruct a run's state from its events (offline, deterministic).
+
+    Args:
+        events: the run's events, any order.
+        run_id: if given, restrict to this run before replay.
+        anchor: trusted external tip hash; a mismatch (tail truncation) raises
+            ``ChainBroken``.
+    """
+    scoped = [e for e in events if e.run_id == run_id] if run_id is not None else events
+    return replay_events(scoped, anchor=anchor)

+"""Real SQLite audit sink (E2).
+
+# Implements: FR-05, NFR-08, NFR-09
+
+``SqliteAuditSink`` implements the public ``egta.contracts.audit``
+``AuditSink``/``AuditReader`` protocols. One transaction per ``append`` writes the
+event and its receipt atomically; UNIQUE(run_id, sequence) raises
+``SequenceConflict`` and UNIQUE(run_id, event_id) with different content raises
+``DuplicateConflict``; any real storage error (mid-write / disk) raises
+``AuditUnavailable`` with the transaction rolled back — no partial rows, no
+receipt (fail-closed).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+
+from egta.contracts.audit import (
+    AuditUnavailable,
+    DuplicateConflict,
+    Receipt,
+    SequenceConflict,
+    recompute_payload_hash,
+)
+from egta.contracts.events import RunEvent
+
+
+class SqliteAuditReader:
+    """``AuditReader`` for one run, sorted by sequence."""
+
+    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
+        self._conn = conn
+
+    def read(self, run_id: str) -> list[RunEvent]:
+        rows = self._conn.execute(
+            "SELECT payload FROM events WHERE run_id = ? ORDER BY sequence ASC",
+            (run_id,),
+        ).fetchall()
+        return [RunEvent.model_validate_json(row[0]) for row in rows]
+
+
+class SqliteAuditSink:
+    """Fail-closed, idempotent SQLite audit sink."""
+
+    store_id = "sqlite"
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str = ":memory:"):
+        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
+        self.conn.executescript(
+            """
+            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
+                run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+                event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+                sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
+                content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+                payload TEXT NOT NULL,
+                PRIMARY KEY (run_id, event_id),
+                UNIQUE (run_id, sequence)
+            );
+            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS receipts (
+                idempotency_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+                content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+                payload TEXT NOT NULL
+            );
+            """
+        )
+
+    def append(self, event: RunEvent) -> Receipt:
+        content = recompute_payload_hash(event)
+        key = f"{event.run_id}:{event.event_id}"
+        try:
+            with self.conn:  # transaction: commit on success, rollback on error
+                row = self.conn.execute(
+                    "SELECT content_hash, payload FROM receipts WHERE idempotency_key = ?",
+                    (key,),
+                ).fetchone()
+                if row is not None:
+                    existing_content, payload_json = row
+                    if existing_content != content:
+                        raise DuplicateConflict(
+                            event.run_id, event.event_id, existing_content, content
+                        )
+                    return Receipt.model_validate_json(payload_json)
+
+                seq_row = self.conn.execute(
+                    "SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id = ? AND sequence = ?",
+                    (event.run_id, event.sequence),
+                ).fetchone()
+                if seq_row is not None:
+                    raise SequenceConflict(
+                        event.run_id, event.sequence, seq_row[0], event.event_id
+                    )
+
+                receipt = Receipt(
+                    schema_version="1.0",
+                    receipt_id=f"rcpt-{key}",
+                    run_id=event.run_id,
+                    event_id=event.event_id,
+                    sequence=event.sequence,
+                    payload_hash=event.payload_hash,
+                    prev_event_hash=event.prev_event_hash,
+                    chain_tip_hash=content,
+                    persisted_at=datetime.now(UTC),
+                    store_id=self.store_id,
+                    transaction_id=key,
+                    idempotency_key=key,
+                )
+                self.conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO events (run_id, event_id, sequence, content_hash, payload) "
+                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (event.run_id, event.event_id, event.sequence, content,
+                     event.model_dump_json()),
+                )
+                self.conn.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO receipts (idempotency_key, content_hash, payload) "
+                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
+                    (key, content, receipt.model_dump_json()),
+                )
+                return receipt
+        except (SequenceConflict, DuplicateConflict):
+            raise
+        except sqlite3.Error as exc:
+            raise AuditUnavailable(event.run_id, "append", str(exc)) from exc
+
+    def read(self, run_id: str) -> SqliteAuditReader:
+        return SqliteAuditReader(self.conn)

+"""Pack-level evidence assembly for FR-01 / INV-02 (module A).
+
+``build_pack`` turns raw provider items into an immutable :class:`EvidencePack`
+and its :class:`~egta.contracts.ExcludedItem` list; ``validate_claims`` fails
+closed on a claim that cites an evidence id the pack does not contain.
+
+# Implements: FR-01 (evidence pack), INV-02 (point-in-time admissibility)
+
+Design decisions frozen by the approved pack-level spec
+(``test/offline/evidence/test_pack.py``, PR #25) and its trace:
+
+* ``pack_hash`` is **computed here**, never supplied by a caller. It is the SHA-256
+  of the canonical ``evidence_fields(pack)`` and therefore equals
+  :func:`egta.risk_gate.canonical.recompute_evidence_hash`; the risk gate recomputes
+  and rejects any mismatch as ``INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`` (``test_pack_hash_matches_risk_gate_canonical``).
+* Claim citations use the **full** evidence id ``<run_id>-<case_local_id>``, matching
+  the risk gate's index (``risk_gate/rules.py`` ``_check_claims``).
+* A dangling citation raises :class:`InvalidCitation` carrying
+  ``ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION`` and naming the bad id.
+* ``source_type == "cache"`` is always stale (``STALE_DATA`` / ``stale``); there is
+  no age-based freshness threshold in this spec.
+* ``pack.items`` preserves raw input order (admitted items only). A duplicate
+  (same ``source_uri`` + publication instant + ``content_hash``) is silently
+  collapsed, not listed as an exclusion.
+* A caller-supplied ``conflict_key`` groups *more than one* admitted item; a single
+  admitted item is never grouped.
+
+Pure time filtering (E-13..E-20, E-27, E-28, E-31) is owned by
+:func:`egta.evidence.time_policy.is_admissible`; this module only wires its verdicts
+into the pack.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+from egta.contracts import Availability, EvidenceItem, EvidencePack, ExcludedItem, RunSpec
+from egta.contracts.events import ReasonCode
+from egta.evidence.time_policy import is_admissible
+from egta.risk_gate.canonical import recompute_evidence_hash
+
+_TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE = "none"
+_INTEGRITY_AVAILABILITY = Availability.UNAVAILABLE
+_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ID = "provider"
+_HASH_ZERO = "0" * 64
+
+
+class InvalidCitation(Exception):
+    """A claim cites an evidence id absent from the pack (``INVALID_CITATION``).
+
+    Carries the offending id so callers can report precisely which citation was
+    dangling without re-parsing the message.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        self.evidence_id = evidence_id
+        self.reason_code = ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION
+        super().__init__(
+            f"{ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION.value}: claim cites unknown evidence id "
+            f"{evidence_id!r}"
+        )
+
+
+def _sha256_hex(text: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _publication_instant(published_at: Any) -> Any:
+    """Normalize ``published_at`` for dedupe keys only (never mutates the item).
+
+    Date-only values collapse to their ``date``; aware datetimes to UTC; naive and
+    malformed values are kept verbatim so distinct bad values stay distinct.
+    """
+    if isinstance(published_at, datetime):
+        return published_at.astimezone(UTC) if published_at.tzinfo is not None else published_at
+    if isinstance(published_at, date):
+        return published_at
+    if isinstance(published_at, str):
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(published_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        except ValueError:
+            return published_at
+        return parsed.astimezone(UTC) if parsed.tzinfo is not None else parsed
+    return published_at
+
+
+def _raw_get(raw: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
+    return raw.get(key, default)
+
+
+def _is_cache(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return _raw_get(raw, "source_type") == "cache"
+
+
+def _is_tampered(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    excerpt = _raw_get(raw, "excerpt")
+    content_hash = _raw_get(raw, "content_hash")
+    if not isinstance(excerpt, str) or not isinstance(content_hash, str):
+        return False
+    return _sha256_hex(excerpt) != content_hash
+
+
+def _dedupe_key(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
+    return (
+        _raw_get(raw, "source_uri"),
+        _publication_instant(_raw_get(raw, "published_at")),
+        _raw_get(raw, "content_hash"),
+    )
+
+
+def _excluded(case_local_id: str, reason: ReasonCode, availability: Availability) -> ExcludedItem:
+    return ExcludedItem(
+        case_local_id=case_local_id,
+        availability=availability,
+        reason_code=reason,
+    )
+
+
+def _to_evidence_item(
+    run_id: str,
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    conflict_group: str | None,
+) -> EvidenceItem:
+    return EvidenceItem(
+        evidence_id=f"{run_id}-{raw['case_local_id']}",
+        source_uri=raw["source_uri"],
+        published_at=raw["published_at"],
+        fetched_at=raw["fetched_at"],
+        content_hash=raw["content_hash"],
+        excerpt=raw["excerpt"],
+        availability=Availability.AVAILABLE,
+        trust_label=raw["trust_label"],
+        reason_code=None,
+        conflict_group=conflict_group,
+    )
+
+
+def _time_verdict(raw: Mapping[str, Any], run_spec: RunSpec):
+    granularity = _raw_get(raw, "time_granularity", _TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE)
+    return is_admissible(
+        published_at=_raw_get(raw, "published_at"),
+        time_granularity=granularity if isinstance(granularity, str) else _TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE,
+        as_of=run_spec.as_of,
+    )
+
+
+def _assemble(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    raw_items: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    provider_error: Any,
+    conflict_key: str | None,
+) -> tuple[list[EvidenceItem], list[ExcludedItem]]:
+    exclusions: list[ExcludedItem] = []
+
+    if provider_error is not None:
+        exclusions.append(
+            _excluded(_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ID, ReasonCode.VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE, Availability.UNREACHABLE)
+        )
+
+    admitted_raw: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = set()
+
+    for raw in raw_items:
+        local_id = _raw_get(raw, "case_local_id")
+        if _is_cache(raw):
+            exclusions.append(_excluded(local_id, ReasonCode.STALE_DATA, Availability.STALE))
+            continue
+        if _is_tampered(raw):
+            exclusions.append(
+                _excluded(local_id, ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, _INTEGRITY_AVAILABILITY)
+            )
+            continue
+        verdict = _time_verdict(raw, run_spec)
+        if not verdict.admissible:
+            exclusions.append(
+                _excluded(local_id, ReasonCode(verdict.reason_code), Availability.UNAVAILABLE)
+            )
+            continue
+        key = _dedupe_key(raw)
+        if key in seen:
+            # Silent collapse: a duplicate is neither admitted nor an exclusion.
+            continue
+        seen.add(key)
+        admitted_raw.append(raw)
+
+    group = conflict_key if (conflict_key is not None and len(admitted_raw) > 1) else None
+    items = [
+        _to_evidence_item(run_spec.run_id, raw, conflict_group=group) for raw in admitted_raw
+    ]
+    return items, exclusions
+
+
+def _pack_with_hash(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    items: list[EvidenceItem],
+    exclusions: list[ExcludedItem],
+) -> EvidencePack:
+    # Build with a placeholder, then bind pack_hash to the canonical recomputation
+    # over the pack's evidence_fields. recompute_evidence_hash ignores pack_hash, so
+    # the placeholder never affects the digest.
+    provisional = EvidencePack(
+        run_id=run_spec.run_id,
+        snapshot_id=run_spec.snapshot_id,
+        items=items,
+        excluded_items=exclusions,
+        cutoff=run_spec.as_of,
+        pack_hash=_HASH_ZERO,
+    )
+    pack_hash = recompute_evidence_hash(provisional)
+    return provisional.model_copy(update={"pack_hash": pack_hash})
+
+
+def build_pack(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    raw_items: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    provider_error: Any = None,
+    conflict_key: str | None = None,
+) -> EvidencePack:
+    """Assemble an :class:`EvidencePack` from raw provider items (FR-01 / INV-02).
+
+    ``provider_error`` (any non-``None`` value) records a single provider-level
+    exclusion (``VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE`` / ``unreachable``). ``conflict_key`` marks a
+    caller-known conflict group across all admitted items when more than one
+    remains after filtering/dedupe.
+    """
+    items, exclusions = _assemble(
+        run_spec,
+        raw_items,
+        provider_error=provider_error,
+        conflict_key=conflict_key,
+    )
+    return _pack_with_hash(run_spec, items, exclusions)
+
+
+def _claim_evidence_ids(claim: Any) -> Iterable[str]:
+    if isinstance(claim, Mapping):
+        return claim.get("evidence_ids", ()) or ()
+    return getattr(claim, "evidence_ids", ()) or ()
+
+
+def validate_claims(pack: EvidencePack, claims: Iterable[Any]) -> None:
+    """Fail closed if any claim cites an evidence id absent from ``pack``.
+
+    Raises :class:`InvalidCitation` naming the first dangling id. Accepts claim
+    mappings or objects exposing ``evidence_ids`` (full ``<run_id>-<case_local_id>``
+    ids, matching the risk gate's index).
+    """
+    known = {item.evidence_id for item in pack.items}
+    for claim in claims:
+        for evidence_id in _claim_evidence_ids(claim):
+            if evidence_id not in known:
+                raise InvalidCitation(str(evidence_id))
+
+
+__all__ = ["InvalidCitation", "build_pack", "validate_claims"]

+"""Canonical JSON and SHA-256 helpers for FR-04 identities.
+
+The canonical form is the proposed shared form: sorted object keys, compact
+separators, UTF-8, Decimal as a fixed-point string, aware datetimes normalized to
+UTC, date-only values as ISO date strings, tuples as arrays, and SHA-256 lowercase
+hex.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+_HASH_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+
+
+def hash_is_valid(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, str) and _HASH_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is not None
+
+
+def _normalize(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, str)):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return format(value, "f")
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            return value.isoformat()
+        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat()
+    if isinstance(value, date):
+        return value.isoformat()
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return repr(value)
+    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
+        return [_normalize(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, (set, frozenset)):
+        return sorted(_normalize(item) for item in value)
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        items = sorted(value.items(), key=lambda pair: str(pair[0]))
+        return {str(key): _normalize(item) for key, item in items}
+    if hasattr(value, "to_canonical_dict"):
+        return _normalize(value.to_canonical_dict())
+    raise TypeError(f"cannot canonicalize {type(value)!r}")
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(
+        _normalize(value),
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def sha256_hex(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _claim_dict(claim: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(claim, Mapping):
+        return {
+            "claim_id": claim.get("claim_id"),
+            "text": claim.get("text"),
+            "evidence_ids": claim.get("evidence_ids", ()),
+            "stance": claim.get("stance"),
+            "counterargument": claim.get("counterargument"),
+            "unresolved": claim.get("unresolved"),
+        }
+    return {
+        "claim_id": getattr(claim, "claim_id", None),
+        "text": getattr(claim, "text", None),
+        "evidence_ids": getattr(claim, "evidence_ids", ()),
+        "stance": getattr(claim, "stance", None),
+        "counterargument": getattr(claim, "counterargument", None),
+        "unresolved": getattr(claim, "unresolved", None),
+    }
+
+
+def _item_dict(item: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+        return {
+            "evidence_id": item.get("evidence_id"),
+            "source_uri": item.get("source_uri"),
+            "published_at": item.get("published_at"),
+            "fetched_at": item.get("fetched_at"),
+            "content_hash": item.get("content_hash"),
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt"),
+            "availability": item.get("availability"),
+            "trust_label": item.get("trust_label"),
+        }
+    return {
+        "evidence_id": getattr(item, "evidence_id", None),
+        "source_uri": getattr(item, "source_uri", None),
+        "published_at": getattr(item, "published_at", None),
+        "fetched_at": getattr(item, "fetched_at", None),
+        "content_hash": getattr(item, "content_hash", None),
+        "excerpt": getattr(item, "excerpt", None),
+        "availability": getattr(item, "availability", None),
+        "trust_label": getattr(item, "trust_label", None),
+    }
+
+
+def proposal_fields(proposal: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    claims = getattr(proposal, "claims", ()) or ()
+    return {
+        "proposal_id": getattr(proposal, "proposal_id", None),
+        "run_id": getattr(proposal, "run_id", None),
+        "ticker": getattr(proposal, "ticker", None),
+        "action": getattr(proposal, "action", None),
+        "quantity": getattr(proposal, "quantity", None),
+        "currency": getattr(proposal, "currency", None),
+        "reference_price": getattr(proposal, "reference_price", None),
+        "price_time": getattr(proposal, "price_time", None),
+        "claims": tuple(_claim_dict(claim) for claim in claims),
+        "evidence_pack_hash": getattr(proposal, "evidence_pack_hash", None),
+        "portfolio_version": getattr(proposal, "portfolio_version", None),
+        "policy_hash": getattr(proposal, "policy_hash", None),
+        "expires_at": getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None),
+    }
+
+
+def policy_fields(policy: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "version": getattr(policy, "version", None),
+        "base_currency": getattr(policy, "base_currency", None),
+        "max_position_pct": getattr(policy, "max_position_pct", None),
+        "max_order_pct": getattr(policy, "max_order_pct", None),
+        "price_freshness_seconds": getattr(policy, "price_freshness_seconds", None),
+        "fee_bps": getattr(policy, "fee_bps", None),
+        "slippage_bps": getattr(policy, "slippage_bps", None),
+        "allowed_actions": getattr(policy, "allowed_actions", frozenset()),
+        "long_only": getattr(policy, "long_only", None),
+        "paper_only": getattr(policy, "paper_only", None),
+        "effective_from": getattr(policy, "effective_from", None),
+        "expires_at": getattr(policy, "expires_at", None),
+        "quantization": getattr(policy, "quantization", None),
+    }
+
+
+def evidence_fields(pack: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    items = getattr(pack, "items", ()) or ()
+    excluded = getattr(pack, "excluded_items", ()) or ()
+    return {
+        "run_id": getattr(pack, "run_id", None),
+        "snapshot_id": getattr(pack, "snapshot_id", None),
+        "items": tuple(_item_dict(item) for item in items),
+        "excluded_items": tuple(_item_dict(item) for item in excluded),
+        "cutoff": getattr(pack, "cutoff", None),
+    }
+
+
+def recompute_proposal_hash(proposal: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(proposal_fields(proposal))
+
+
+def recompute_policy_hash(policy: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(policy_fields(policy))
+
+
+def recompute_evidence_hash(pack: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(evidence_fields(pack))
+
+
+def payload_hash(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """SHA-256 over contracts.audit's canonical RunEvent JSON.
+
+    ``contracts.audit.recompute_payload_hash`` uses Pydantic
+    ``model_dump(mode="json")`` plus ``json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True,
+    separators=(",", ":"))``. UTC datetimes therefore render with a trailing
+    ``Z``. Keep this byte-compatible; otherwise an outbox event that is valid
+    for the risk gate is rejected by E's verify_payload/replay.
+    """
+    canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

@@ -0,0 +1,348 @@
+"""SQLite paper ledger, idempotency, and audit outbox for FR-04."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sqlite3
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from .canonical import payload_hash
+from .models import (
+    PortfolioSnapshot,
+    Position,
+    ReasonCode,
+    RiskVerdict,
+    VerdictStatus,
+)
+
+_SCHEMA = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolios (
+    portfolio_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    base_currency TEXT NOT NULL,
+    cash TEXT NOT NULL,
+    as_of TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS positions (
+    portfolio_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
+    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    mark_price TEXT NOT NULL,
+    PRIMARY KEY (portfolio_id, symbol)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ledger_entries (
+    entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    proposal_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    verdict_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    side TEXT NOT NULL,
+    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    exec_price TEXT NOT NULL,
+    fee TEXT NOT NULL,
+    cash_after TEXT NOT NULL,
+    position_after INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS risk_verdicts (
+    verdict_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    proposal_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL,
+    reasons TEXT NOT NULL,
+    checked_rules TEXT NOT NULL,
+    portfolio_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    expires_at TEXT,
+    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox_events (
+    schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
+    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    phase TEXT NOT NULL,
+    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
+    duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    status TEXT NOT NULL,
+    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+    prev_event_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
+    metrics TEXT NOT NULL,
+    reason_code TEXT,
+    UNIQUE (run_id, sequence)
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (
+    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    value TEXT NOT NULL
+);
+"""
+
+
+def connect(db_path: str | Path, busy_timeout_seconds: float) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    connection = sqlite3.connect(
+        str(Path(db_path)),
+        timeout=busy_timeout_seconds,
+        isolation_level=None,
+    )
+    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+    connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
+    connection.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {int(busy_timeout_seconds * 1000)}")
+    return connection
+
+
+def initialize(db_path: str | Path, portfolio: Any) -> None:
+    connection = connect(db_path, 5.0)
+    try:
+        connection.executescript(_SCHEMA)
+        existing = connection.execute(
+            "SELECT 1 FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id = ?",
+            (portfolio.portfolio_id,),
+        ).fetchone()
+        if existing is None:
+            connection.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO portfolios "
+                "(portfolio_id, version, base_currency, cash, as_of) "
+                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (
+                    portfolio.portfolio_id,
+                    int(portfolio.version),
+                    portfolio.base_currency,
+                    str(portfolio.cash),
+                    portfolio.as_of.isoformat(),
+                ),
+            )
+            for position in portfolio.positions:
+                connection.execute(
+                    "INSERT INTO positions "
+                    "(portfolio_id, symbol, quantity, mark_price) "
+                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                    (
+                        portfolio.portfolio_id,
+                        position.symbol,
+                        int(position.quantity),
+                        str(position.mark_price),
+                    ),
+                )
+        connection.execute(
+            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_meta (key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '1')"
+        )
+        connection.commit()
+    finally:
+        connection.close()
+
+
+def read_portfolio(connection: sqlite3.Connection, portfolio_id: str) -> PortfolioSnapshot:
+    row = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT version, base_currency, cash, as_of "
+        "FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id = ?",
+        (portfolio_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        raise KeyError(f"portfolio {portfolio_id!r} not found")
+    positions = tuple(
+        Position(
+            symbol=item["symbol"],
+            quantity=int(item["quantity"]),
+            mark_price=Decimal(str(item["mark_price"])),
+        )
+        for item in connection.execute(
+            "SELECT symbol, quantity, mark_price FROM positions "
+            "WHERE portfolio_id = ? ORDER BY symbol",
+            (portfolio_id,),
+        )
+    )
+    return PortfolioSnapshot(
+        portfolio_id=portfolio_id,
+        version=int(row["version"]),
+        base_currency=row["base_currency"],
+        cash=Decimal(str(row["cash"])),
+        positions=positions,
+        as_of=datetime.fromisoformat(row["as_of"]),
+    )
+
+
+def read_verdict(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection, proposal_hash: str
+) -> RiskVerdict | None:
+    row = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT verdict_id, proposal_hash, status, reasons, checked_rules, "
+        "portfolio_version, expires_at "
+        "FROM risk_verdicts WHERE proposal_hash = ?",
+        (proposal_hash,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    if row is None:
+        return None
+    reasons = tuple(ReasonCode(value) for value in json.loads(row["reasons"]))
+    checked = tuple(json.loads(row["checked_rules"]))
+    expires_at = (
+        datetime.fromisoformat(row["expires_at"]) if row["expires_at"] else None
+    )
+    return RiskVerdict(
+        proposal_hash=row["proposal_hash"],
+        status=VerdictStatus(row["status"]),
+        reasons=reasons,
+        checked_rules=checked,
+        portfolio_version=int(row["portfolio_version"]),
+        expires_at=expires_at,
+        verdict_id=row["verdict_id"],
+    )
+
+
+def store_verdict(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection, verdict: RiskVerdict, created_at: datetime
+) -> None:
+    connection.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO risk_verdicts "
+        "(verdict_id, proposal_hash, status, reasons, checked_rules, "
+        "portfolio_version, expires_at, created_at) "
+        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+        (
+            verdict.verdict_id,
+            verdict.proposal_hash,
+            verdict.status.value,
+            json.dumps([reason.value for reason in verdict.reasons]),
+            json.dumps(list(verdict.checked_rules)),
+            verdict.portfolio_version,
+            verdict.expires_at.isoformat() if verdict.expires_at else None,
+            created_at.isoformat(),
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def store_ledger_entry(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
+    *,
+    proposal_hash: str,
+    verdict_id: str,
+    side: str,
+    quantity: int,
+    exec_price: Decimal,
+    fee: Decimal,
+    cash_after: Decimal,
+    position_after: int,
+    created_at: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    connection.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO ledger_entries "
+        "(entry_id, proposal_hash, verdict_id, side, quantity, exec_price, fee, "
+        "cash_after, position_after, created_at) "
+        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+        (
+            uuid4().hex,
+            proposal_hash,
+            verdict_id,
+            side,
+            quantity,
+            str(exec_price),
+            str(fee),
+            str(cash_after),
+            position_after,
+            created_at.isoformat(),
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def update_portfolio(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
+    *,
+    portfolio_id: str,
+    old_version: int,
+    new_version: int,
+    cash_after: Decimal,
+    position_symbol: str,
+    position_after: int,
+    mark_price: Decimal,
+    as_of: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    cursor = connection.execute(
+        "UPDATE portfolios SET version = ?, cash = ?, as_of = ? "
+        "WHERE portfolio_id = ? AND version = ?",
+        (
+            new_version,
+            str(cash_after),
+            as_of.isoformat(),
+            portfolio_id,
+            old_version,
+        ),
+    )
+    if cursor.rowcount != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError("portfolio version conflict")
+    connection.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO positions (portfolio_id, symbol, quantity, mark_price) "
+        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) "
+        "ON CONFLICT(portfolio_id, symbol) DO UPDATE SET "
+        "quantity = excluded.quantity, mark_price = excluded.mark_price",
+        (portfolio_id, position_symbol, position_after, str(mark_price)),
+    )
+
+
+def store_outbox_event(
+    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
+    *,
+    run_id: str,
+    status: str,
+    reason_code: str | None,
+    metrics: dict[str, Any],
+    timestamp: datetime,
+) -> None:
+    row = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), -1) + 1 AS next_sequence "
+        "FROM outbox_events WHERE run_id = ?",
+        (run_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    sequence = int(row["next_sequence"])
+    previous = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT payload_hash FROM outbox_events WHERE run_id = ? "
+        "ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1",
+        (run_id,),
+    ).fetchone()
+    prev_hash = previous["payload_hash"] if previous is not None else ""
+    event_id = uuid4().hex
+    timestamp_iso = timestamp.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "1.0",
+        "event_id": event_id,
+        "run_id": run_id,
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "phase": "risk_gate",
+        "timestamp": timestamp_iso,
+        "duration_ms": 0,
+        "status": status,
+        "prev_event_hash": prev_hash,
+        "metrics": metrics,
+        "reason_code": reason_code,
+    }
+    digest = payload_hash(payload)
+    connection.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO outbox_events "
+        "(schema_version, event_id, run_id, sequence, phase, timestamp, "
+        "duration_ms, status, payload_hash, prev_event_hash, metrics, reason_code) "
+        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
+        (
+            "1.0",
+            event_id,
+            run_id,
+            sequence,
+            "risk_gate",
+            timestamp_iso,
+            0,
+            status,
+            digest,
+            prev_hash,
+            json.dumps(metrics, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")),
+            reason_code,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def snapshot(db_path: str | Path, portfolio_id: str) -> PortfolioSnapshot:
+    connection = connect(db_path, 5.0)
+    try:
+        return read_portfolio(connection, portfolio_id)
+    finally:
+        connection.close()

+"""Deterministic policy validation for the FR-04 risk gate."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+from .canonical import hash_is_valid, recompute_policy_hash
+from .models import ReasonCode, VerdictStatus
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RiskPolicy:
+    version: str
+    policy_hash: str
+    base_currency: str
+    max_position_pct: Decimal | None
+    max_order_pct: Decimal | None
+    price_freshness_seconds: int | None
+    fee_bps: Decimal | None
+    slippage_bps: Decimal | None
+    allowed_actions: frozenset[str]
+    long_only: bool
+    paper_only: bool
+    effective_from: datetime | None
+    expires_at: datetime | None
+    quantization: Decimal | None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PolicyIssue:
+    status: VerdictStatus
+    reason: ReasonCode
+
+
+def _is_decimal(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, Decimal)
+
+
+def _is_int(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+
+
+def _is_aware(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return (
+        isinstance(value, datetime)
+        and value.tzinfo is not None
+        and value.utcoffset() is not None
+    )
+
+
+def check_policy(policy: Any, now: datetime) -> PolicyIssue | None:
+    if policy is None:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+
+    stored_hash = getattr(policy, "policy_hash", None)
+    if not hash_is_valid(stored_hash):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.REJECTED, ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION)
+    try:
+        computed_hash = recompute_policy_hash(policy)
+    except Exception:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.REJECTED, ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION)
+    if computed_hash != stored_hash:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.REJECTED, ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION)
+
+    version = getattr(policy, "version", None)
+    base_currency = getattr(policy, "base_currency", None)
+    max_position = getattr(policy, "max_position_pct", None)
+    max_order = getattr(policy, "max_order_pct", None)
+    freshness = getattr(policy, "price_freshness_seconds", None)
+    fee_bps = getattr(policy, "fee_bps", None)
+    slippage_bps = getattr(policy, "slippage_bps", None)
+    quantization = getattr(policy, "quantization", None)
+
+    if not isinstance(version, str) or not version:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(base_currency, str) or not base_currency:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(max_position, Decimal) or not (
+        Decimal(0) < max_position <= Decimal(1)
+    ):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(max_order, Decimal) or not (
+        Decimal(0) < max_order <= Decimal(1)
+    ):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(freshness, int) or isinstance(freshness, bool) or freshness <= 0:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(fee_bps, Decimal) or fee_bps < 0:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(slippage_bps, Decimal) or slippage_bps < 0:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not isinstance(quantization, Decimal) or quantization <= 0:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+
+    allowed = set(getattr(policy, "allowed_actions", ()) or ())
+    if not {"BUY", "SELL", "HOLD"} <= allowed:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if getattr(policy, "long_only", None) is not True:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if getattr(policy, "paper_only", None) is not True:
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+
+    effective = getattr(policy, "effective_from", None)
+    expires = getattr(policy, "expires_at", None)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(effective, datetime)
+        or effective.tzinfo is None
+        or effective.utcoffset() is None
+    ):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(expires, datetime)
+        or expires.tzinfo is None
+        or expires.utcoffset() is None
+    ):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+    if not (effective <= now < expires):
+        return PolicyIssue(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE)
+
+    return None

+"""Deterministic FR-04 rules and limit calculations."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any
+
+from .canonical import hash_is_valid, recompute_evidence_hash
+from .models import ReasonCode, VerdictStatus
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Decision:
+    status: VerdictStatus
+    reasons: tuple[ReasonCode, ...]
+    checked_rules: tuple[str, ...]
+    side: str | None = None
+    quantity: int | None = None
+    exec_price: Decimal | None = None
+    fee: Decimal | None = None
+    cash_after: Decimal | None = None
+    position_after: int | None = None
+    nav_after: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def executes(self) -> bool:
+        return self.side is not None
+
+
+def _decision(
+    status: VerdictStatus, reason: ReasonCode, checked: str
+) -> Decision:
+    return Decision(status=status, reasons=(reason,), checked_rules=(checked,))
+
+
+def _reject(reason: ReasonCode, checked: str) -> Decision:
+    return _decision(VerdictStatus.REJECTED, reason, checked)
+
+
+def _review(reason: ReasonCode, checked: str) -> Decision:
+    return _decision(VerdictStatus.REVIEW, reason, checked)
+
+
+def _blocked(reason: ReasonCode, checked: str) -> Decision:
+    return _decision(VerdictStatus.BLOCKED, reason, checked)
+
+
+def _is_int(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
+
+
+def _is_aware(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return (
+        isinstance(value, datetime)
+        and value.tzinfo is not None
+        and value.utcoffset() is not None
+    )
+
+
+def _parse_price(value: Any) -> Decimal | None:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return value if value.is_finite() else None
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return Decimal(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            parsed = Decimal(value)
+        except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+            return None
+        return parsed if parsed.is_finite() else None
+    return None
+
+
+def _quantize(value: Decimal, quantum: Decimal | None) -> Decimal:
+    if quantum is None:
+        return value
+    return value.quantize(quantum, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+
+
+def _check_claims(claims: Any, evidence_pack: Any) -> Decision | None:
+    if not claims:
+        return None
+    items = getattr(evidence_pack, "items", ()) or ()
+    by_id = {getattr(item, "evidence_id", None): item for item in items}
+    for claim in claims:
+        evidence_ids = getattr(claim, "evidence_ids", ()) or ()
+        if not evidence_ids:
+            return _review(ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION, "claims")
+        usable = False
+        missing = False
+        causes: list[ReasonCode] = []
+        for evidence_id in evidence_ids:
+            item = by_id.get(evidence_id)
+            if item is None:
+                missing = True
+                continue
+            availability = getattr(item, "availability", None)
+            if availability == "available":
+                usable = True
+            elif availability == "unreachable":
+                causes.append(ReasonCode.VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE)
+            elif availability == "stale":
+                causes.append(ReasonCode.STALE_DATA)
+            else:
+                causes.append(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING)
+        if usable:
+            continue
+        if missing:
+            return _review(ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION, "claims")
+        if causes:
+            return _review(causes[0], "evidence_availability")
+        return _review(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING, "claims")
+    return None
+
+
+def decide(
+    proposal: Any,
+    evidence_pack: Any,
+    db_portfolio: Any,
+    current_portfolio: Any,
+    policy: Any,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> Decision:
+    action = getattr(proposal, "action", None)
+    if action not in {"BUY", "SELL", "HOLD"}:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "action")
+    allowed = set(getattr(policy, "allowed_actions", ()) or ())
+    if action not in allowed:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "action")
+
+    proposal_version = getattr(proposal, "portfolio_version", None)
+    current_version = getattr(current_portfolio, "version", None)
+    db_version = getattr(db_portfolio, "version", None)
+    if not _is_int(proposal_version):
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "portfolio_version")
+    if current_version != db_version or proposal_version != db_version:
+        if proposal_version != db_version:
+            return Decision(
+                status=VerdictStatus.STALE_PORTFOLIO,
+                reasons=(ReasonCode.STALE_PORTFOLIO,),
+                checked_rules=("portfolio_version",),
+            )
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.STALE_PORTFOLIO, "portfolio_version")
+
+    cash = getattr(db_portfolio, "cash", None)
+    base_currency = getattr(db_portfolio, "base_currency", None)
+    positions = tuple(getattr(db_portfolio, "positions", ()) or ())
+    if not isinstance(cash, Decimal) or cash < 0:
+        return _blocked(ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE, "portfolio")
+    if not isinstance(base_currency, str) or not base_currency:
+        return _blocked(ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE, "portfolio")
+    for position in positions:
+        quantity = getattr(position, "quantity", None)
+        mark_price = getattr(position, "mark_price", None)
+        if not isinstance(quantity, int) or isinstance(quantity, bool) or quantity < 0:
+            return _blocked(ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE, "portfolio")
+        if not isinstance(mark_price, Decimal) or mark_price <= 0:
+            return _blocked(ReasonCode.INCOMPATIBLE_STATE, "portfolio")
+
+    ticker = getattr(proposal, "ticker", None)
+    quantity = getattr(proposal, "quantity", None)
+    reference_price = getattr(proposal, "reference_price", None)
+    currency = getattr(proposal, "currency", None)
+    price_time = getattr(proposal, "price_time", None)
+    expires_at = getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None)
+    claims = getattr(proposal, "claims", ()) or ()
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+
+    if action in {"BUY", "SELL"}:
+        if not isinstance(ticker, str) or not ticker:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "ticker")
+        if not isinstance(quantity, int) or isinstance(quantity, bool) or quantity <= 0:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "quantity")
+        price = _parse_price(reference_price)
+        if price is None or price <= 0:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "reference_price")
+        if not isinstance(currency, str) or not currency:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT, "currency")
+        if not claims:
+            return _review(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING, "claims")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(price_time, datetime)
+            or price_time.tzinfo is None
+            or price_time.utcoffset() is None
+        ):
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_TIME, "price_time")
+
+    if (
+        not isinstance(expires_at, datetime)
+        or expires_at.tzinfo is None
+        or expires_at.utcoffset() is None
+    ):
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INVALID_TIME, "expires_at")
+    assert isinstance(expires_at, datetime)
+
+    if evidence_pack is None:
+        return _review(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING, "evidence")
+    pack_hash = getattr(evidence_pack, "pack_hash", None)
+    if not hash_is_valid(pack_hash):
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, "evidence_hash")
+    try:
+        computed_pack_hash = recompute_evidence_hash(evidence_pack)
+    except Exception:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, "evidence_hash")
+    if computed_pack_hash != pack_hash:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, "evidence_hash")
+    if getattr(proposal, "evidence_pack_hash", None) != pack_hash:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, "evidence_binding")
+    if getattr(proposal, "run_id", None) != getattr(evidence_pack, "run_id", None):
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, "evidence_run")
+
+    if action in {"BUY", "SELL"}:
+        assert isinstance(price_time, datetime)
+        if price_time > now:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.FUTURE_DATA, "price_time")
+        cutoff = getattr(evidence_pack, "cutoff", None)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(cutoff, datetime)
+            or cutoff.tzinfo is None
+            or cutoff.utcoffset() is None
+            or cutoff < price_time
+        ):
+            return _review(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING, "evidence_cutoff")
+        freshness = int(policy.price_freshness_seconds)
+        if (now - price_time).total_seconds() > freshness:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.STALE_DATA, "price_freshness")
+    else:
+        if (
+            isinstance(price_time, datetime)
+            and price_time.tzinfo is not None
+            and price_time.utcoffset() is not None
+        ):
+            cutoff = getattr(evidence_pack, "cutoff", None)
+            if (
+                not isinstance(cutoff, datetime)
+                or cutoff.tzinfo is None
+                or cutoff.utcoffset() is None
+                or cutoff < price_time
+            ):
+                return _review(ReasonCode.EVIDENCE_MISSING, "evidence_cutoff")
+
+    if expires_at <= now:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "expiry")
+
+    claim_issue = _check_claims(claims, evidence_pack)
+    if claim_issue is not None:
+        return claim_issue
+
+    if action == "HOLD":
+        return Decision(
+            status=VerdictStatus.APPROVED,
+            reasons=(),
+            checked_rules=(
+                "policy",
+                "portfolio",
+                "proposal",
+                "evidence",
+                "time",
+                "hold",
+            ),
+        )
+
+    policy_currency = getattr(policy, "base_currency", None)
+    if currency != policy_currency or currency != base_currency:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "currency")
+
+    assert isinstance(ticker, str)
+    assert isinstance(quantity, int) and not isinstance(quantity, bool)
+    assert price is not None
+    position_map = {
+        getattr(position, "symbol", None): position for position in positions
+    }
+    current = position_map.get(ticker)
+    current_quantity = int(getattr(current, "quantity", 0)) if current is not None else 0
+    if action == "SELL" and quantity > current_quantity:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "holdings")
+
+    nav_before = cash + sum(
+        (position.quantity * position.mark_price for position in positions),
+        Decimal(0),
+    )
+    if nav_before <= 0:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "nav")
+
+    slippage = Decimal(policy.slippage_bps) / Decimal(10000)
+    if action == "BUY":
+        exec_price = price * (Decimal(1) + slippage)
+    else:
+        exec_price = price * (Decimal(1) - slippage)
+    if exec_price <= 0:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "exec_price")
+
+    notional = Decimal(quantity) * exec_price
+    fee = notional * Decimal(policy.fee_bps) / Decimal(10000)
+    if action == "BUY":
+        cash_after = cash - notional - fee
+        position_after = current_quantity + quantity
+    else:
+        cash_after = cash + notional - fee
+        position_after = current_quantity - quantity
+
+    other_value = sum(
+        (
+            position.quantity * position.mark_price
+            for position in positions
+            if getattr(position, "symbol", None) != ticker
+        ),
+        Decimal(0),
+    )
+    nav_after = cash_after + other_value + Decimal(position_after) * exec_price
+    if cash_after < 0:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "cash")
+    if notional > Decimal(policy.max_order_pct) * nav_before:
+        return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "notional")
+    if action == "BUY":
+        if nav_after <= 0:
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "nav_after")
+        concentration = Decimal(position_after) * exec_price / nav_after
+        if concentration > Decimal(policy.max_position_pct):
+            return _reject(ReasonCode.POLICY_REJECTED, "concentration")
+
+    quantum = getattr(policy, "quantization", None)
+    return Decision(
+        status=VerdictStatus.APPROVED,
+        reasons=(),
+        checked_rules=(
+            "policy",
+            "portfolio",
+            "proposal",
+            "evidence",
+            "time",
+            "currency",
+            "limits",
+        ),
+        side=action,
+        quantity=quantity,
+        exec_price=exec_price,
+        fee=_quantize(fee, quantum),
+        cash_after=_quantize(cash_after, quantum),
+        position_after=position_after,
+        nav_after=nav_after,
+    )

+"""RiskGate orchestration: validate, decide, and commit atomically."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from . import ledger
+from .canonical import hash_is_valid, recompute_proposal_hash
+from .models import ReasonCode, RiskVerdict, VerdictStatus
+from .policy import check_policy
+from .rules import Decision, decide
+
+
+class RiskGate:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        db_path: str | Path,
+        policy: Any,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None,
+        busy_timeout_seconds: float = 5.0,
+        _fault_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._db_path = Path(db_path)
+        self._policy = policy
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._busy_timeout = float(busy_timeout_seconds)
+        self._fault_hook = _fault_hook
+        self._portfolio_id = "portfolio-1"
+
+    def ensure_initialized(self, portfolio: Any) -> None:
+        ledger.initialize(self._db_path, portfolio)
+        self._portfolio_id = getattr(portfolio, "portfolio_id", self._portfolio_id)
+
+    def snapshot(self) -> Any:
+        return ledger.snapshot(self._db_path, self._portfolio_id)
+
+    def evaluate_and_commit(
+        self,
+        proposal: Any,
+        evidence_pack: Any,
+        current_portfolio: Any,
+    ) -> RiskVerdict:
+        now = self._now()
+        connection = None
+        try:
+            connection = ledger.connect(self._db_path, self._busy_timeout)
+            connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
+            portfolio_id = getattr(
+                current_portfolio, "portfolio_id", self._portfolio_id
+            )
+            db_portfolio = ledger.read_portfolio(connection, portfolio_id)
+
+            supplied_hash = getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", None)
+            if not hash_is_valid(supplied_hash):
+                return self._finish(
+                    connection,
+                    proposal,
+                    db_portfolio,
+                    Decision(
+                        status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
+                        reasons=(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT,),
+                        checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
+                    ),
+                    now,
+                )
+            try:
+                computed_hash = recompute_proposal_hash(proposal)
+            except Exception:
+                return self._finish(
+                    connection,
+                    proposal,
+                    db_portfolio,
+                    Decision(
+                        status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
+                        reasons=(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT,),
+                        checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
+                    ),
+                    now,
+                )
+            if computed_hash != supplied_hash:
+                return self._finish(
+                    connection,
+                    proposal,
+                    db_portfolio,
+                    Decision(
+                        status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
+                        reasons=(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION,),
+                        checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
+                    ),
+                    now,
+                )
+
+            existing = ledger.read_verdict(connection, supplied_hash)
+            if existing is not None:
+                connection.rollback()
+                connection.close()
+                return existing
+
+            policy_issue = check_policy(self._policy, now)
+            if policy_issue is not None:
+                return self._finish(
+                    connection,
+                    proposal,
+                    db_portfolio,
+                    Decision(
+                        status=policy_issue.status,
+                        reasons=(policy_issue.reason,),
+                        checked_rules=("policy",),
+                    ),
+                    now,
+                )
+            if getattr(proposal, "policy_hash", None) != getattr(
+                self._policy, "policy_hash", None
+            ):
+                return self._finish(
+                    connection,
+                    proposal,
+                    db_portfolio,
+                    Decision(
+                        status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
+                        reasons=(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION,),
+                        checked_rules=("policy_hash",),
+                    ),
+                    now,
+                )
+
+            decision = decide(
+                proposal,
+                evidence_pack,
+                db_portfolio,
+                current_portfolio,
+                self._policy,
+                now,
+            )
+            return self._finish(
+                connection, proposal, db_portfolio, decision, now
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            if connection is not None:
+                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+                    connection.rollback()
+                with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+                    connection.close()
+            return self._blocked_verdict(proposal, current_portfolio)
+
+    def _finish(
+        self,
+        connection: Any,
+        proposal: Any,
+        db_portfolio: Any,
+        decision: Decision,
+        now: datetime,
+    ) -> RiskVerdict:
+        expires_at = getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None)
+        verdict = RiskVerdict(
+            proposal_hash=getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", ""),
+            status=decision.status,
+            reasons=decision.reasons,
+            checked_rules=decision.checked_rules,
+            portfolio_version=db_portfolio.version,
+            expires_at=expires_at if isinstance(expires_at, datetime) else None,
+            verdict_id=uuid4().hex,
+        )
+        ledger.store_verdict(connection, verdict, now)
+
+        if decision.executes:
+            assert decision.side is not None
+            assert decision.quantity is not None
+            assert decision.exec_price is not None
+            assert decision.fee is not None
+            assert decision.cash_after is not None
+            assert decision.position_after is not None
+            ledger.store_ledger_entry(
+                connection,
+                proposal_hash=verdict.proposal_hash,
+                verdict_id=verdict.verdict_id,
+                side=decision.side,
+                quantity=decision.quantity,
+                exec_price=decision.exec_price,
+                fee=decision.fee,
+                cash_after=decision.cash_after,
+                position_after=decision.position_after,
+                created_at=now,
+            )
+            self._call_hook("after_ledger_insert")
+            ledger.update_portfolio(
+                connection,
+                portfolio_id=db_portfolio.portfolio_id,
+                old_version=db_portfolio.version,
+                new_version=db_portfolio.version + 1,
+                cash_after=decision.cash_after,
+                position_symbol=getattr(proposal, "ticker", ""),
+                position_after=decision.position_after,
+                mark_price=decision.exec_price,
+                as_of=now,
+            )
+
+        ledger.store_outbox_event(
+            connection,
+            run_id=getattr(proposal, "run_id", None) or "run-1",
+            status=self._event_status(decision.status),
+            reason_code=self._event_reason(decision),
+            metrics=self._metrics(verdict, decision),
+            timestamp=now,
+        )
+        self._call_hook("after_outbox_insert")
+        self._call_hook("before_commit")
+        connection.commit()
+        connection.close()
+        return verdict
+
+    def _blocked_verdict(self, proposal: Any, current_portfolio: Any) -> RiskVerdict:
+        expires_at = getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None)
+        return RiskVerdict(
+            proposal_hash=getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", ""),
+            status=VerdictStatus.BLOCKED,
+            reasons=(ReasonCode.AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE,),
+            checked_rules=("audit",),
+            portfolio_version=getattr(current_portfolio, "version", 0),
+            expires_at=expires_at if isinstance(expires_at, datetime) else None,
+            verdict_id=uuid4().hex,
+        )
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        value = self._clock() if self._clock is not None else datetime.now(UTC)
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:

+"""Helpers for the offline Phase 7 governance checker specification."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+CHECK_PERMISSIONS = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "check_permissions.py"
+CHECK_APPROVAL = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "check_approval.py"
+
+
+class GitRepo:
+    def __init__(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        self.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        self._git("init")
+        self._git("config", "user.email", "agent@example.test")
+        self._git("config", "user.name", "Agent")
+
+    def _git(self, *args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+        return subprocess.run(
+            ["git", *args],
+            cwd=self.path,
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def head(self) -> str:
+        return self._git("rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
+
+    def commit(
+        self,
+        files: dict[str, str] | None = None,
+        message: str = "change",
+        delete: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    ) -> str:
+        for relative, content in (files or {}).items():
+            target = self.path / relative
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
+        for relative in delete:
+            target = self.path / relative
+            if target.exists():
+                target.unlink()
+        self._git("add", "-A")
+        self._git("commit", "-m", message)
+        return self.head
+
+
+def run_permissions(
+    repo: GitRepo,
+    base: str,
+    head: str,
+    role: str = "build-d",
+    json_output: bool = False,
+) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    args = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(CHECK_PERMISSIONS),
+        "--repo",
+        str(repo.path),
+        "--base",
+        base,
+        "--head",
+        head,
+        "--role",
+        role,
+    ]
+    if json_output:
+        args.append("--json")
+    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=repo.path, capture_output=True, text=True)
+
+
+def run_approval(
+    repo: GitRepo,
+    record: str,
+    implementation_base: str,
+    implementation_head: str,
+    registry: str | Path,
+    author: str = "ZFebron491001",
+    json_output: bool = False,
+) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    args = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(CHECK_APPROVAL),
+        "--repo",
+        str(repo.path),
+        "--record",
+        record,
+        "--implementation-base",
+        implementation_base,
+        "--implementation-head",
+        implementation_head,
+        "--registry",
+        str(registry),
+        "--author",
+        author,
+    ]
+    if json_output:
+        args.append("--json")
+    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=repo.path, capture_output=True, text=True)
