+"""Canonical JSON and SHA-256 helpers shared across modules.
+
+Relocated here from ``egta.risk_gate.canonical`` so that the canonical form is a
+*contract-level* concern: both the risk gate (D) and the evidence pack (A) must
+produce byte-identical hashes for ``evidence_hash`` / ``proposal_hash`` /
+``policy_hash``. Importing this from ``egta.contracts`` keeps every business
+module within the allowed "contracts + own module" import boundary (AGENTS.md
+§3, NFR-06) instead of depending on another business module's private code.
+
+The canonical form: sorted object keys, compact separators, UTF-8, Decimal as a
+fixed-point string, aware datetimes normalized to UTC, date-only values as ISO
+date strings, tuples as arrays, and SHA-256 lowercase hex.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+
+_HASH_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+
+
+def hash_is_valid(value: Any) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, str) and _HASH_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is not None
+
+
+def _normalize(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, str)):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        return format(value, "f")
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            return value.isoformat()
+        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat()
+    if isinstance(value, date):
+        return value.isoformat()
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return repr(value)
+    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
+        return [_normalize(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, (set, frozenset)):
+        return sorted(_normalize(item) for item in value)
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        items = sorted(value.items(), key=lambda pair: str(pair[0]))
+        return {str(key): _normalize(item) for key, item in items}
+    if hasattr(value, "to_canonical_dict"):
+        return _normalize(value.to_canonical_dict())
+    raise TypeError(f"cannot canonicalize {type(value)!r}")
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(
+        _normalize(value),
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def sha256_hex(value: Any) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _claim_dict(claim: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(claim, Mapping):
+        return {
+            "claim_id": claim.get("claim_id"),
+            "text": claim.get("text"),
+            "evidence_ids": claim.get("evidence_ids", ()),
+            "stance": claim.get("stance"),
+            "counterargument": claim.get("counterargument"),
+            "unresolved": claim.get("unresolved"),
+        }
+    return {
+        "claim_id": getattr(claim, "claim_id", None),
+        "text": getattr(claim, "text", None),
+        "evidence_ids": getattr(claim, "evidence_ids", ()),
+        "stance": getattr(claim, "stance", None),
+        "counterargument": getattr(claim, "counterargument", None),
+        "unresolved": getattr(claim, "unresolved", None),
+    }
+
+
+def _item_dict(item: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+        return {
+            "evidence_id": item.get("evidence_id"),
+            "source_uri": item.get("source_uri"),
+            "published_at": item.get("published_at"),
+            "fetched_at": item.get("fetched_at"),
+            "content_hash": item.get("content_hash"),
+            "excerpt": item.get("excerpt"),
+            "availability": item.get("availability"),
+            "trust_label": item.get("trust_label"),
+        }
+    return {
+        "evidence_id": getattr(item, "evidence_id", None),
+        "source_uri": getattr(item, "source_uri", None),
+        "published_at": getattr(item, "published_at", None),
+        "fetched_at": getattr(item, "fetched_at", None),
+        "content_hash": getattr(item, "content_hash", None),
+        "excerpt": getattr(item, "excerpt", None),
+        "availability": getattr(item, "availability", None),
+        "trust_label": getattr(item, "trust_label", None),
+    }
+
+
+def proposal_fields(proposal: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    claims = getattr(proposal, "claims", ()) or ()
+    return {
+        "proposal_id": getattr(proposal, "proposal_id", None),
+        "run_id": getattr(proposal, "run_id", None),
+        "ticker": getattr(proposal, "ticker", None),
+        "action": getattr(proposal, "action", None),
+        "quantity": getattr(proposal, "quantity", None),
+        "currency": getattr(proposal, "currency", None),
+        "reference_price": getattr(proposal, "reference_price", None),
+        "price_time": getattr(proposal, "price_time", None),
+        "claims": tuple(_claim_dict(claim) for claim in claims),
+        "evidence_pack_hash": getattr(proposal, "evidence_pack_hash", None),
+        "portfolio_version": getattr(proposal, "portfolio_version", None),
+        "policy_hash": getattr(proposal, "policy_hash", None),
+        "expires_at": getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None),
+    }
+
+
+def policy_fields(policy: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "version": getattr(policy, "version", None),
+        "base_currency": getattr(policy, "base_currency", None),
+        "max_position_pct": getattr(policy, "max_position_pct", None),
+        "max_order_pct": getattr(policy, "max_order_pct", None),
+        "price_freshness_seconds": getattr(policy, "price_freshness_seconds", None),
+        "fee_bps": getattr(policy, "fee_bps", None),
+        "slippage_bps": getattr(policy, "slippage_bps", None),
+        "allowed_actions": getattr(policy, "allowed_actions", frozenset()),
+        "long_only": getattr(policy, "long_only", None),
+        "paper_only": getattr(policy, "paper_only", None),
+        "effective_from": getattr(policy, "effective_from", None),
+        "expires_at": getattr(policy, "expires_at", None),
+        "quantization": getattr(policy, "quantization", None),
+    }
+
+
+def evidence_fields(pack: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    items = getattr(pack, "items", ()) or ()
+    excluded = getattr(pack, "excluded_items", ()) or ()
+    return {
+        "run_id": getattr(pack, "run_id", None),
+        "snapshot_id": getattr(pack, "snapshot_id", None),
+        "items": tuple(_item_dict(item) for item in items),
+        "excluded_items": tuple(_item_dict(item) for item in excluded),
+        "cutoff": getattr(pack, "cutoff", None),
+    }
+
+
+def recompute_proposal_hash(proposal: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(proposal_fields(proposal))
+
+
+def recompute_policy_hash(policy: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(policy_fields(policy))
+
+
+def recompute_evidence_hash(pack: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(evidence_fields(pack))
+
+
+def payload_hash(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """SHA-256 over contracts.audit's canonical RunEvent JSON.
+
+    ``contracts.audit.recompute_payload_hash`` uses Pydantic
+    ``model_dump(mode="json")`` plus ``json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True,
+    separators=(",", ":"))``. UTC datetimes therefore render with a trailing
+    ``Z``. Keep this byte-compatible; otherwise an outbox event that is valid
+    for the risk gate is rejected by E's verify_payload/replay.
+    """
+    canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

+"""Pack-level evidence assembly for FR-01 / INV-02 (module A).
+
+``build_pack`` turns raw provider items into an immutable :class:`EvidencePack`
+and its :class:`~egta.contracts.ExcludedItem` list; ``validate_claims`` fails
+closed on a claim that cites an evidence id the pack does not contain.
+
+# Implements: FR-01 (evidence pack), INV-02 (point-in-time admissibility)
+
+Design decisions frozen by the approved pack-level spec
+(``test/offline/evidence/test_pack.py``, PR #25) and its trace:
+
+* ``pack_hash`` is **computed here**, never supplied by a caller. It is the SHA-256
+  of the canonical ``evidence_fields(pack)`` and therefore equals
+  :func:`egta.contracts.canonical.recompute_evidence_hash`; the risk gate recomputes
+  and rejects any mismatch as ``INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`` (``test_pack_hash_matches_risk_gate_canonical``).
+* Claim citations use the **full** evidence id ``<run_id>-<case_local_id>``, matching
+  the risk gate's index (``risk_gate/rules.py`` ``_check_claims``).
+* A dangling citation raises :class:`InvalidCitation` carrying
+  ``ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION`` and naming the bad id.
+* ``source_type == "cache"`` is always stale (``STALE_DATA`` / ``stale``); there is
+  no age-based freshness threshold in this spec.
+* Classification order is integrity -> staleness -> time -> dedupe, so a tampered
+  cache item is ``INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`` and a future cache item is ``STALE_DATA``
+  (see ``_assemble`` and ``trace-FR-01-pack.md``).
+* ``pack.items`` preserves raw input order (admitted items only). A duplicate
+  (same ``source_uri`` + publication instant + ``content_hash``) is silently
+  collapsed, not listed as an exclusion.
+* A caller-supplied ``conflict_key`` groups *more than one* admitted item; a single
+  admitted item is never grouped.
+
+Pure time filtering (E-13..E-20, E-27, E-28, E-31) is owned by
+:func:`egta.evidence.time_policy.is_admissible`; this module only wires its verdicts
+into the pack.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+from egta.contracts import Availability, EvidenceItem, EvidencePack, ExcludedItem, RunSpec
+from egta.contracts.canonical import recompute_evidence_hash
+from egta.contracts.events import ReasonCode
+from egta.evidence.time_policy import is_admissible
+
+_TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE = "none"
+_INTEGRITY_AVAILABILITY = Availability.UNAVAILABLE
+_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ID = "provider"
+_HASH_ZERO = "0" * 64
+
+
+class InvalidCitation(Exception):
+    """A claim cites an evidence id absent from the pack (``INVALID_CITATION``).
+
+    Carries the offending id so callers can report precisely which citation was
+    dangling without re-parsing the message.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, evidence_id: str) -> None:
+        self.evidence_id = evidence_id
+        self.reason_code = ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION
+        super().__init__(
+            f"{ReasonCode.INVALID_CITATION.value}: claim cites unknown evidence id "
+            f"{evidence_id!r}"
+        )
+
+
+def _sha256_hex(text: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _publication_instant(published_at: Any) -> Any:
+    """Normalize ``published_at`` for dedupe keys only (never mutates the item).
+
+    Date-only values collapse to their ``date``; aware datetimes to UTC; naive and
+    malformed values are kept verbatim so distinct bad values stay distinct.
+    """
+    if isinstance(published_at, datetime):
+        return published_at.astimezone(UTC) if published_at.tzinfo is not None else published_at
+    if isinstance(published_at, date):
+        return published_at
+    if isinstance(published_at, str):
+        try:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(published_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        except ValueError:
+            return published_at
+        return parsed.astimezone(UTC) if parsed.tzinfo is not None else parsed
+    return published_at
+
+
+def _raw_get(raw: Mapping[str, Any], key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
+    return raw.get(key, default)
+
+
+def _is_cache(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return _raw_get(raw, "source_type") == "cache"
+
+
+def _is_tampered(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    excerpt = _raw_get(raw, "excerpt")
+    content_hash = _raw_get(raw, "content_hash")
+    if not isinstance(excerpt, str) or not isinstance(content_hash, str):
+        return False
+    return _sha256_hex(excerpt) != content_hash
+
+
+def _dedupe_key(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
+    return (
+        _raw_get(raw, "source_uri"),
+        _publication_instant(_raw_get(raw, "published_at")),
+        _raw_get(raw, "content_hash"),
+    )
+
+
+def _excluded(case_local_id: str, reason: ReasonCode, availability: Availability) -> ExcludedItem:
+    return ExcludedItem(
+        case_local_id=case_local_id,
+        availability=availability,
+        reason_code=reason,
+    )
+
+
+def _to_evidence_item(
+    run_id: str,
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    conflict_group: str | None,
+) -> EvidenceItem:
+    return EvidenceItem(
+        evidence_id=f"{run_id}-{raw['case_local_id']}",
+        source_uri=raw["source_uri"],
+        published_at=raw["published_at"],
+        fetched_at=raw["fetched_at"],
+        content_hash=raw["content_hash"],
+        excerpt=raw["excerpt"],
+        availability=Availability.AVAILABLE,
+        trust_label=raw["trust_label"],
+        reason_code=None,
+        conflict_group=conflict_group,
+    )
+
+
+def _time_verdict(raw: Mapping[str, Any], run_spec: RunSpec):
+    granularity = _raw_get(raw, "time_granularity", _TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE)
+    return is_admissible(
+        published_at=_raw_get(raw, "published_at"),
+        time_granularity=granularity if isinstance(granularity, str) else _TIME_GRANULARITY_NONE,
+        as_of=run_spec.as_of,
+    )
+
+
+def _assemble(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    raw_items: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    provider_error: Any,
+    conflict_key: str | None,
+) -> tuple[list[EvidenceItem], list[ExcludedItem]]:
+    exclusions: list[ExcludedItem] = []
+
+    if provider_error is not None:
+        exclusions.append(
+            _excluded(_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ID, ReasonCode.VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE, Availability.UNREACHABLE)
+        )
+
+    admitted_raw: list[Mapping[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = set()
+
+    # Precedence (frozen by trace-FR-01-pack.md "classification rule"):
+    #   1. integrity  — a hash/excerpt mismatch is INTEGRITY_VIOLATION regardless
+    #      of source_type, so a *tampered cache item* is reported as tampering, not
+    #      silently downgraded to STALE (audit correctness for FR-01/T04).
+    #   2. staleness  — a well-formed ``source_type == "cache"`` item is always
+    #      STALE_DATA/stale (frozen E-26 rule; no age threshold).
+    #   3. time       — INV-02 point-in-time admissibility via time_policy.
+    #   4. dedupe     — collapse identical (uri, publication instant, content_hash).
+    # A future-dated *cache* item therefore classifies as STALE at step 2 (cache is
+    # unverifiable off-line) rather than FUTURE_DATA at step 3; a future-dated
+    # *non-cache* item classifies as FUTURE_DATA at step 3.
+    for raw in raw_items:
+        local_id = _raw_get(raw, "case_local_id")
+        if _is_tampered(raw):
+            exclusions.append(
+                _excluded(local_id, ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, _INTEGRITY_AVAILABILITY)
+            )
+            continue
+        if _is_cache(raw):
+            exclusions.append(_excluded(local_id, ReasonCode.STALE_DATA, Availability.STALE))
+            continue
+        verdict = _time_verdict(raw, run_spec)
+        if not verdict.admissible:
+            exclusions.append(
+                _excluded(local_id, ReasonCode(verdict.reason_code), Availability.UNAVAILABLE)
+            )
+            continue
+        key = _dedupe_key(raw)
+        if key in seen:
+            # Silent collapse: a duplicate is neither admitted nor an exclusion.
+            continue
+        seen.add(key)
+        admitted_raw.append(raw)
+
+    group = conflict_key if (conflict_key is not None and len(admitted_raw) > 1) else None
+    items = [
+        _to_evidence_item(run_spec.run_id, raw, conflict_group=group) for raw in admitted_raw
+    ]
+    return items, exclusions
+
+
+def _pack_with_hash(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    items: list[EvidenceItem],
+    exclusions: list[ExcludedItem],
+) -> EvidencePack:
+    # Build with a placeholder, then bind pack_hash to the canonical recomputation
+    # over the pack's evidence_fields. recompute_evidence_hash ignores pack_hash, so
+    # the placeholder never affects the digest.
+    provisional = EvidencePack(
+        run_id=run_spec.run_id,
+        snapshot_id=run_spec.snapshot_id,
+        items=items,
+        excluded_items=exclusions,
+        cutoff=run_spec.as_of,
+        pack_hash=_HASH_ZERO,
+    )
+    pack_hash = recompute_evidence_hash(provisional)
+    return provisional.model_copy(update={"pack_hash": pack_hash})
+
+
+def build_pack(
+    run_spec: RunSpec,
+    raw_items: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    provider_error: Any = None,
+    conflict_key: str | None = None,
+) -> EvidencePack:
+    """Assemble an :class:`EvidencePack` from raw provider items (FR-01 / INV-02).
+
+    ``provider_error`` (any non-``None`` value) records a single provider-level
+    exclusion (``VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE`` / ``unreachable``). ``conflict_key`` marks a
+    caller-known conflict group across all admitted items when more than one
+    remains after filtering/dedupe.
+    """
+    items, exclusions = _assemble(
+        run_spec,
+        raw_items,
+        provider_error=provider_error,
+        conflict_key=conflict_key,
+    )
+    return _pack_with_hash(run_spec, items, exclusions)
+
+
+def _claim_evidence_ids(claim: Any) -> Iterable[str]:
+    if isinstance(claim, Mapping):
+        return claim.get("evidence_ids", ()) or ()
+    return getattr(claim, "evidence_ids", ()) or ()
+
+
+def validate_claims(pack: EvidencePack, claims: Iterable[Any]) -> None:
+    """Fail closed if any claim cites an evidence id absent from ``pack``.
+
+    Raises :class:`InvalidCitation` naming the first dangling id. Accepts claim
+    mappings or objects exposing ``evidence_ids`` (full ``<run_id>-<case_local_id>``
+    ids, matching the risk gate's index).
+    """
+    known = {item.evidence_id for item in pack.items}
+    for claim in claims:
+        for evidence_id in _claim_evidence_ids(claim):
+            if evidence_id not in known:
+                raise InvalidCitation(str(evidence_id))
+
+
+__all__ = ["InvalidCitation", "build_pack", "validate_claims"]

     version INTEGER NOT NULL,
     base_currency TEXT NOT NULL,
     cash TEXT NOT NULL,

 );

 def connect(db_path: str | Path, busy_timeout_seconds: float) -> sqlite3.Connection:
     connection = sqlite3.connect(
         str(Path(db_path)),
         timeout=busy_timeout_seconds,
         isolation_level=None,
     )
     connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
     connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
     connection.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {int(busy_timeout_seconds * 1000)}")
     return connection
 
 
 def initialize(db_path: str | Path, portfolio: Any) -> None:
     connection = connect(db_path, 5.0)
     try:
         connection.executescript(_SCHEMA)
         existing = connection.execute(
             "SELECT 1 FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id = ?",
             (portfolio.portfolio_id,),
         ).fetchone()
         if existing is None:
             connection.execute(
                 "INSERT INTO portfolios "
                 "(portfolio_id, version, base_currency, cash, as_of) "
                 "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                 (
                     portfolio.portfolio_id,
                     int(portfolio.version),
                     portfolio.base_currency,
                     str(portfolio.cash),
                     portfolio.as_of.isoformat(),
                 ),
             )
             for position in portfolio.positions:
                 connection.execute(
                     "INSERT INTO positions "
                     "(portfolio_id, symbol, quantity, mark_price) "
                     "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                     (
                         portfolio.portfolio_id,
                         position.symbol,
                         int(position.quantity),
                         str(position.mark_price),
                     ),
                 )

             "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_meta (key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '1')"
         )
         connection.commit()

         connection.close()

     row = connection.execute(
         "SELECT version, base_currency, cash, as_of "
         "FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id = ?",
         (portfolio_id,),
     ).fetchone()
     if row is None:
         raise KeyError(f"portfolio {portfolio_id!r} not found")
     positions = tuple(
         Position(
             symbol=item["symbol"],
             quantity=int(item["quantity"]),
             mark_price=Decimal(str(item["mark_price"])),
         )
         for item in connection.execute(
             "SELECT symbol, quantity, mark_price FROM positions "
             "WHERE portfolio_id = ? ORDER BY symbol",
             (portfolio_id,),
         )
     )
     return PortfolioSnapshot(

         version=int(row["version"]),
         base_currency=row["base_currency"],

     )
 
 
 def read_verdict(
     connection: sqlite3.Connection, proposal_hash: str
 ) -> RiskVerdict | None:
     row = connection.execute(
         "SELECT verdict_id, proposal_hash, status, reasons, checked_rules, "
         "portfolio_version, expires_at "
         "FROM risk_verdicts WHERE proposal_hash = ?",
         (proposal_hash,),

         expires_at=expires_at,

 def store_verdict(

 ) -> None:

     )
 
 
 def update_portfolio(
     connection: sqlite3.Connection,
     *,

 def store_outbox_event(
     connection: sqlite3.Connection,
     *,
     run_id: str,
     status: str,
     reason_code: str | None,
     metrics: dict[str, Any],
     timestamp: datetime,
 ) -> None:
     row = connection.execute(
         "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), -1) + 1 AS next_sequence "
         "FROM outbox_events WHERE run_id = ?",
         (run_id,),
     ).fetchone()
     sequence = int(row["next_sequence"])
     previous = connection.execute(
         "SELECT payload_hash FROM outbox_events WHERE run_id = ? "
         "ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1",
         (run_id,),
     ).fetchone()
     prev_hash = previous["payload_hash"] if previous is not None else ""
     event_id = uuid4().hex
     timestamp_iso = timestamp.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
     payload = {
         "schema_version": "1.0",
         "event_id": event_id,
         "run_id": run_id,
         "sequence": sequence,
         "phase": "risk_gate",
         "timestamp": timestamp_iso,
         "duration_ms": 0,
         "status": status,
         "prev_event_hash": prev_hash,
         "metrics": metrics,
         "reason_code": reason_code,
     }
     digest = payload_hash(payload)
     connection.execute(
         "INSERT INTO outbox_events "
         "(schema_version, event_id, run_id, sequence, phase, timestamp, "
         "duration_ms, status, payload_hash, prev_event_hash, metrics, reason_code) "
         "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
         (
             "1.0",
             event_id,
             run_id,
             sequence,
             "risk_gate",
             timestamp_iso,
             0,
             status,
             digest,
             prev_hash,
             json.dumps(metrics, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")),
             reason_code,
         ),
     )
 
 
 def snapshot(db_path: str | Path, portfolio_id: str) -> PortfolioSnapshot:
     connection = connect(db_path, 5.0)
     try:
         return read_portfolio(connection, portfolio_id)
     finally:
         connection.close()

 class RiskGate:
     def __init__(
         self,
         db_path: str | Path,
         policy: Any,
         clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None,
         busy_timeout_seconds: float = 5.0,
         _fault_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
     ) -> None:
         self._db_path = Path(db_path)
         self._policy = policy
         self._clock = clock
         self._busy_timeout = float(busy_timeout_seconds)
         self._fault_hook = _fault_hook
         self._portfolio_id = "portfolio-1"
 
     def ensure_initialized(self, portfolio: Any) -> None:
         ledger.initialize(self._db_path, portfolio)
         self._portfolio_id = getattr(portfolio, "portfolio_id", self._portfolio_id)
 
     def snapshot(self) -> Any:
         return ledger.snapshot(self._db_path, self._portfolio_id)
 
     def evaluate_and_commit(
         self,
         proposal: Any,
         evidence_pack: Any,
         current_portfolio: Any,
     ) -> RiskVerdict:
         now = self._now()
         connection = None
         try:
             connection = ledger.connect(self._db_path, self._busy_timeout)
             connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
             portfolio_id = getattr(
                 current_portfolio, "portfolio_id", self._portfolio_id
             )
             db_portfolio = ledger.read_portfolio(connection, portfolio_id)
 
             supplied_hash = getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", None)
             if not hash_is_valid(supplied_hash):
                 return self._finish(
                     connection,
                     proposal,
                     db_portfolio,
                     Decision(
                         status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
                         reasons=(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT,),
                         checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
                     ),
                     now,
                 )
             try:
                 computed_hash = recompute_proposal_hash(proposal)
             except Exception:
                 return self._finish(
                     connection,
                     proposal,
                     db_portfolio,
                     Decision(
                         status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
                         reasons=(ReasonCode.INVALID_OUTPUT,),
                         checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
                     ),
                     now,
                 )
             if computed_hash != supplied_hash:
                 return self._finish(
                     connection,
                     proposal,
                     db_portfolio,
                     Decision(
                         status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
                         reasons=(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION,),
                         checked_rules=("proposal_hash",),
                     ),
                     now,
                 )
 
             existing = ledger.read_verdict(connection, supplied_hash)
             if existing is not None:
                 connection.rollback()
                 connection.close()
                 return existing
 
             policy_issue = check_policy(self._policy, now)
             if policy_issue is not None:
                 return self._finish(
                     connection,
                     proposal,
                     db_portfolio,
                     Decision(
                         status=policy_issue.status,
                         reasons=(policy_issue.reason,),
                         checked_rules=("policy",),
                     ),
                     now,
                 )
             if getattr(proposal, "policy_hash", None) != getattr(
                 self._policy, "policy_hash", None
             ):
                 return self._finish(
                     connection,
                     proposal,
                     db_portfolio,
                     Decision(
                         status=VerdictStatus.REJECTED,
                         reasons=(ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION,),
                         checked_rules=("policy_hash",),
                     ),
                     now,
                 )
 
             decision = decide(
                 proposal,
                 evidence_pack,
                 db_portfolio,
                 current_portfolio,
                 self._policy,
                 now,
             )
             return self._finish(
                 connection, proposal, db_portfolio, decision, now
             )
         except Exception:
             if connection is not None:
                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                     connection.rollback()
                 with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
                     connection.close()
             return self._blocked_verdict(proposal, current_portfolio)
 
     def _finish(
         self,
         connection: Any,
         proposal: Any,
         db_portfolio: Any,
         decision: Decision,
         now: datetime,
     ) -> RiskVerdict:
         expires_at = getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None)
         verdict = RiskVerdict(
             proposal_hash=getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", ""),
             status=decision.status,
             reasons=decision.reasons,
             checked_rules=decision.checked_rules,
             portfolio_version=db_portfolio.version,
             expires_at=expires_at if isinstance(expires_at, datetime) else None,
             verdict_id=uuid4().hex,
         )
         ledger.store_verdict(connection, verdict, now)
 
         if decision.executes:
             assert decision.side is not None
             assert decision.quantity is not None
             assert decision.exec_price is not None
             assert decision.fee is not None
             assert decision.cash_after is not None
             assert decision.position_after is not None
             ledger.store_ledger_entry(
                 connection,
                 proposal_hash=verdict.proposal_hash,
                 verdict_id=verdict.verdict_id,
                 side=decision.side,
                 quantity=decision.quantity,
                 exec_price=decision.exec_price,
                 fee=decision.fee,
                 cash_after=decision.cash_after,
                 position_after=decision.position_after,
                 created_at=now,
             )
             self._call_hook("after_ledger_insert")
             ledger.update_portfolio(
                 connection,
                 portfolio_id=db_portfolio.portfolio_id,
                 old_version=db_portfolio.version,
                 new_version=db_portfolio.version + 1,
                 cash_after=decision.cash_after,
                 position_symbol=getattr(proposal, "ticker", ""),
                 position_after=decision.position_after,
                 mark_price=decision.exec_price,
                 as_of=now,
             )
 
         ledger.store_outbox_event(
             connection,
             run_id=getattr(proposal, "run_id", None) or "run-1",
             status=self._event_status(decision.status),
             reason_code=self._event_reason(decision),
             metrics=self._metrics(verdict, decision),
             timestamp=now,
         )
         self._call_hook("after_outbox_insert")
         self._call_hook("before_commit")
         connection.commit()
         connection.close()
         return verdict
 
     def _blocked_verdict(self, proposal: Any, current_portfolio: Any) -> RiskVerdict:
         expires_at = getattr(proposal, "expires_at", None)
         return RiskVerdict(
             proposal_hash=getattr(proposal, "proposal_hash", ""),
             status=VerdictStatus.BLOCKED,
             reasons=(ReasonCode.AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE,),
             checked_rules=("audit",),
             portfolio_version=getattr(current_portfolio, "version", 0),
             expires_at=expires_at if isinstance(expires_at, datetime) else None,
             verdict_id=uuid4().hex,
         )
 
     def _now(self) -> datetime:
         value = self._clock() if self._clock is not None else datetime.now(UTC)
         if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
             return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
         return value.astimezone(UTC)
 
     def _call_hook(self, stage: str) -> None:
         if self._fault_hook is not None:
             self._fault_hook(stage)
 
     @staticmethod
     def _event_status(status: VerdictStatus) -> str:
         if status is VerdictStatus.APPROVED:
             return "ok"
         if status is VerdictStatus.REVIEW:
             return "review"
         return "blocked"
 
     @staticmethod
     def _event_reason(decision: Decision) -> str | None:
         if not decision.reasons:
             return None
         return decision.reasons[0].value
 
     @staticmethod
     def _metrics(verdict: RiskVerdict, decision: Decision) -> dict[str, Any]:
         metrics: dict[str, Any] = {
             "verdict_id": verdict.verdict_id,
             "proposal_hash": verdict.proposal_hash,
             "ledger_committed": decision.executes,
         }
         if decision.executes:
             metrics.update(
                 {
                     "side": decision.side,
                     "cash_after": str(decision.cash_after),
                     "position_after": decision.position_after,
                     "nav_after": str(decision.nav_after),
                 }
             )
         return metrics

"""FR-01 evidence classification precedence: integrity -> staleness -> time.

Companion to the frozen pack spec (``test_pack.py``, PR #25). It pins the
*precedence* among exclusion causes that the frozen spec leaves open, so a
tampered cache item is reported as ``INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`` (audit correctness,
FR-01/T04) and a future-dated cache item is ``STALE_DATA`` (cache is
unverifiable off-line, E-26 rule), rather than whichever check happens to run
first.

This file is additive only; it does not modify or replace ``test_pack.py``.
It is selected by ``-m spec`` like the rest of the FR-01 pack suite.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.spec


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def precedence_api():
    from egta.contracts import Availability, RunSpec
    from egta.contracts.events import ReasonCode
    from egta.evidence.pack import build_pack

    class _Api:
        pass

    api = _Api()
    api.Availability = Availability
    api.RunSpec = RunSpec
    api.ReasonCode = ReasonCode
    api.build_pack = staticmethod(build_pack)
    return api


def _run_spec(api, case: dict) -> object:
    return api.RunSpec(
        schema_version="1.0",
        run_id=f"run-{case['case_id']}",
        ticker="AAPL",
        as_of=case["as_of"],
        mode="enhanced",
        model_config_hash="1" * 64,
        prompt_hash="2" * 64,
        policy_hash="3" * 64,
        snapshot_id=f"snap-{case['case_id']}",
        limits={},
    )


def _rehash(raw: dict) -> dict:
    """Return a copy whose content_hash matches its (tampered) excerpt."""
    copy = dict(raw)
    copy["content_hash"] = hashlib.sha256(copy["excerpt"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return copy


def test_tampered_cache_is_integrity_not_stale(precedence_api, load_case):
    """A cache item whose excerpt was altered is INTEGRITY_VIOLATION, not STALE."""
    api = precedence_api
    case = load_case("E-26")  # clean cache item: source_type == "cache"
    raw = dict(case["items"][0])
    raw["excerpt"] = raw["excerpt"] + " [tampered]"
    # keep the OLD content_hash so sha256(excerpt) != content_hash -> tampered
    run_spec = _run_spec(api, case)

    pack = api.build_pack(run_spec, [raw])
    assert pack.items == []
    assert len(pack.excluded_items) == 1
    bad = pack.excluded_items[0]
    assert bad.case_local_id == raw["case_local_id"]
    assert bad.reason_code == api.ReasonCode.INTEGRITY_VIOLATION
    assert bad.availability == api.Availability.UNAVAILABLE


def test_well_formed_cache_still_stale(precedence_api, load_case):
    """Control: an untampered cache item is still STALE_DATA (E-26 unchanged)."""
    api = precedence_api
    case = load_case("E-26")
    raw = case["items"][0]
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw["excerpt"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == raw["content_hash"]
    run_spec = _run_spec(api, case)

    pack = api.build_pack(run_spec, [raw])
    assert pack.items == []
    bad = pack.excluded_items[0]
    assert bad.reason_code == api.ReasonCode.STALE_DATA
    assert bad.availability == api.Availability.STALE


def test_future_cache_is_stale_not_future_data(precedence_api, load_case):
    """A future-dated *cache* item is STALE_DATA (unverifiable off-line), not FUTURE."""
    api = precedence_api
    case = load_case("E-26")
    raw = dict(case["items"][0])
    # Move publication AFTER as_of (2026-11-11T00:00:00Z) but keep it consistent.
    raw["published_at"] = "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"
    raw["fetched_at"] = "2026-12-01T00:05:00Z"
    raw = _rehash(raw)  # excerpt unchanged, still well-formed (not tampered)
    run_spec = _run_spec(api, case)

    pack = api.build_pack(run_spec, [raw])
    assert pack.items == []
    bad = pack.excluded_items[0]
    # cache is classified as stale before the time filter runs.
    assert bad.reason_code == api.ReasonCode.STALE_DATA
    assert bad.availability == api.Availability.STALE


def test_future_non_cache_is_future_data(precedence_api, load_case):
    """Control: a future-dated non-cache item is FUTURE_DATA (time filter)."""
    api = precedence_api
    case = load_case("E-16")  # future-dated fred item, non-cache
    raw = case["items"][0]
    run_spec = _run_spec(api, case)

    pack = api.build_pack(run_spec, [raw])
    assert pack.items == []
    bad = pack.excluded_items[0]
    assert bad.reason_code == api.ReasonCode.FUTURE_DATA
    assert bad.availability == api.Availability.UNAVAILABLE

input.content:
# Trace — FR-01 classification-precedence spec (test-first)

Requirement-to-test trace for `test/offline/evidence/test_pack_precedence.py`
(this spec PR). It is **test/spec only — no implementation**; the implementation
lands in the descendant FR-01 impl PR (which must descend from this spec's merge
commit per GATE-01).

## What this branch is / is not

- **Is**: 4 additive pack-level cases that pin the *classification precedence*
  among exclusion causes. The frozen pack spec `test_pack.py`
  (`test-hash-FR-01-pack.txt`, `actual_cases: 33`) and its trace
  `docs/req/trace-FR-01-pack.md` do not cover these.
- **Is not**: the 33 frozen cases; any `src/` change; any implementation.
- **RED by design**: `pytest -m spec test/offline/evidence/test_pack_precedence.py`
  → 4 errors (`ImportError: cannot import name 'InvalidCitation' from 'egta.evidence'`
  / `egta.evidence.pack` absent), no xfail/skip.

## Contract-level decision (not implementation-defined)

Classification runs **integrity → staleness → time → dedupe**, first match wins.
The cache step rests on the E-26 rule already frozen in
`docs/req/trace-FR-01-pack.md` ("`source_type == "cache"` is always stale
(`STALE_DATA`/`stale`); no freshness threshold"). This spec makes the *ordering*
of that rule against integrity and time explicit; it is not "whatever the
implementation does" — the tests below assert it.

## Precedence and INV-02 reconciliation

INV-02 freezes: a date-only/day value on the same UTC date is excluded with
`FUTURE_DATA`, never `INVALID_TIME`, and `future_items_admitted == 0`. The cache
rule does not violate INV-02:

- A **future-dated cache** item is still **excluded** (never admitted), so the
  INV-02 metric `future_items_admitted == 0` still holds. It is reported as
  `STALE_DATA` rather than `FUTURE_DATA` because the cache check is a
  broader/stronger reason (off-line cache is unverifiable regardless of its
  date), and it runs before the time filter. `STALE_DATA` and `FUTURE_DATA` are
  both `availability != available`; the reason code differs but the item is not
  admitted either way.
- A **future non-cache** item is excluded with `FUTURE_DATA`, exactly as INV-02
  requires (control case).
- INV-02's own time-policy suite (`test_time_policy.py`) and the frozen pack
  cases (E-16 FUTURE_DATA, E-17 EVIDENCE_MISSING) are unchanged and still pass.

INTEGRITY before staleness: a tampered cache item (excerpt hash mismatch) is
`INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`, not `STALE_DATA`. Integrity is the most specific,
audit-critical cause (FR-01/T04); downgrading a tampered item to a generic
"stale" would hide tampering.

## Test function → requirement mapping

| Test function | Covers | Input | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_tampered_cache_is_integrity_not_stale` | FR-01 (audit/T04), INV-02 (excluded) | cache item, sha256(excerpt)!=content_hash | INTEGRITY_VIOLATION / unavailable |
| `test_well_formed_cache_still_stale` | FR-01, E-26 rule (control) | clean cache item | STALE_DATA / stale |
| `test_future_cache_is_stale_not_future_data` | INV-02 (future not admitted), precedence | cache item, published_at after as_of | STALE_DATA / stale |
| `test_future_non_cache_is_future_data` | INV-02 (control) | non-cache item, future (E-16) | FUTURE_DATA / unavailable |

## Approval

- On D approval: fill `reviewed_pr_head`, `merge_commit`, `approved_by` in
  `docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt`.
- The descendant impl PR's CI evidence gate reads expected = 33 (frozen record) +
  4 (this record) = 37 for the `evidence` suite, via `RECORDS:` (not hardcoded).

# Trace — FR-01 evidence pack implementation (A) + classification precedence

Implementation-side trace for the FR-01 `build_pack` / `validate_claims`
implementation (PR for `src/egta/evidence/pack.py`). The **frozen** pack spec and
its trace live in `test/offline/evidence/test_pack.py` and
`docs/req/trace-FR-01-pack.md` (PR #25, merged `f9ca5d1`); this file does not
modify them. It documents the implementation boundary and the additive
classification-precedence tests `test/offline/evidence/test_pack_precedence.py`.

## Frozen spec vs. additive cases

| Suite | File | Cases | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Frozen pack spec (#25) | `test_pack.py` | 33 | approved by D; hash `75fc9dc5…`, unchanged |
| Classification precedence (this PR) | `test_pack_precedence.py` | 4 | additive; selected by `-m spec` |

Total FR-01 evidence spec cases = **37** (CI `EXPECT_EVIDENCE=37`).

## Classification precedence (resolves D's audit-precedence question)

`_assemble` classifies each raw item in this order, first match wins:

1. **integrity** — `sha256(excerpt) != content_hash` → `INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`
   (availability `unavailable`). Runs *before* the cache check, so a **tampered
   cache item** is reported as tampering, not silently downgraded to stale. This
   is the FR-01/T04 audit-correct choice.
2. **staleness** — well-formed `source_type == "cache"` → `STALE_DATA`
   (availability `stale`). Frozen E-26 rule; no age threshold.
3. **time** — INV-02 admissibility via `egta.evidence.time_policy.is_admissible`
   (`FUTURE_DATA` / `EVIDENCE_MISSING` / `INVALID_TIME`).
4. **dedupe** — collapse identical `(source_uri, publication instant, content_hash)`;
   a duplicate is neither admitted nor excluded.

Consequences pinned by tests:

| Test | Input | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| `test_tampered_cache_is_integrity_not_stale` | cache item, `sha256(excerpt) != content_hash` | `INTEGRITY_VIOLATION` / `unavailable` |
| `test_well_formed_cache_still_stale` | clean cache item (control) | `STALE_DATA` / `stale` (E-26 unchanged) |
| `test_future_cache_is_stale_not_future_data` | cache item, `published_at` after `as_of` | `STALE_DATA` / `stale` (cache staged before time filter) |
| `test_future_non_cache_is_future_data` | non-cache item, future (E-16) | `FUTURE_DATA` / `unavailable` |

## Cross-module import boundary (NFR-06 / AGENTS.md §3)

`build_pack` needs the *same* canonical hash the risk gate recomputes, or the
pack is rejected as `INTEGRITY_VIOLATION`. Importing `egta.risk_gate.canonical`
from `egta.evidence` would be a forbidden cross-module import. Fix:

- The canonical helpers moved to `egta.contracts.canonical` (shared, dependency-free,
  operates on contract types). Both business modules now import it from
  `egta.contracts`, which is the only cross-module dependency a module may have.
- `egta/risk_gate/canonical.py` is kept as a thin re-export shim so existing
  importers (`test/offline/risk_gate/test_evidence_time_policy.py`, D's gate code)
  keep working.
- `egta.evidence.pack` imports only `egta.contracts*` and its own module.

This is a shared-contracts change (B-owned); it must be reviewed by the contracts
custodian in addition to D. No algorithm change — the canonical form and
`recompute_evidence_hash` output are byte-identical (risk_gate 139 tests and
contracts 288 tests still pass).

## Verification

- evidence spec: `pytest -m spec test/offline/evidence` → 37 passed.
- evidence not-spec: `pytest -m "not spec" test/offline/evidence` → 13 passed (INV-02).
- risk_gate: `pytest test/offline/risk_gate` → 139 passed (A→D equality intact).
- contracts: `pytest -m spec test/offline/contracts` → 288 passed.
- CI offline gate (local simulation of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`): evidence
  `passed=37 expected=37 -> OK`; all suites OK; exit 0.
- ruff clean; mypy clean.

fi

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GATE-01 — approval-record checker. N/A (exit 0 + ::notice::) when
  # requirements.yaml is absent, no src/test change, or no matched record.
  # Module -> record MAP uses PRECISE paths so FR-01 evidence tests (which live
  # under test/offline/contracts/) route to FR-01-evidence, NOT FR-05-contracts.
  #   src/egta/contracts/ | src/egta/evaluation/ | test/offline/contracts/  (minus evidence) -> FR-05-contracts
  #   src/egta/evidence/  | test/offline/evidence/  | test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts.py -> FR-01-evidence
  #   src/egta/risk_gate/ | test/offline/risk_gate/ -> FR-04-risk-gate
  #   src/egta/budget/ ... -> FR-02-budget
  # A single change may match several modules -> the loop checks EACH record.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  check-approval:
    name: check-approval (GATE-01)
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with: { python-version: "3.12" }
      - name: Check approval records for each changed module
        run: |
          base="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
          head="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
          git fetch --no-tags origin "$base" "$head" || true
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$head")
          if [ ! -f docs/req/requirements.yaml ]; then echo "::notice::requirements.yaml absent -- N/A"; exit 0; fi
          if ! echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(src|test)/'; then echo "::notice::no src/test change -- N/A"; exit 0; fi

          # Precise module detectors (evidence first, then contract/eval).
          hit_evidence=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/evidence/|^test/offline/evidence/|^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_fr05=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/contracts/|^src/egta/evaluation/|^test/offline/contracts/' | grep -v '^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_risk=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/risk_gate/|^test/offline/risk_gate/' || true)
          hit_budget=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/budget/' || true)

          fail=0; ran=0
          check() {
            mod="$1"; hit="$2"
            if [ -n "$hit" ]; then
              rec="docs/approvals/test-hash-${mod}.txt"
              if [ ! -f "$rec" ]; then echo "::notice::no record $rec -- N/A for $mod"; return; fi
              apbase=$(grep -E '^test_content_commit:' "$rec" | awk '{print $2}')
              echo "--- check-approval $mod (base=$apbase) ---"
              ran=$((ran+1))
              python tools/check_approval.py --repo . --record "$rec" \
                --implementation-base "$apbase" --implementation-head "$head" \
                --registry docs/req/requirements.yaml \
                --author "${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" || fail=1
            fi
          }
          check FR-01-evidence   "$hit_evidence"
          check FR-05-contracts  "$hit_fr05"
          check FR-04-risk-gate  "$hit_risk"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GATE-01 — approval-record checker. N/A (exit 0 + ::notice::) when
  # requirements.yaml is absent, no src/test change, or no matched record.
  # Module -> record MAP uses PRECISE paths so FR-01 evidence tests (which live
  # under test/offline/contracts/) route to FR-01-evidence, NOT FR-05-contracts.
  #   src/egta/contracts/ | src/egta/evaluation/ | test/offline/contracts/  (minus evidence) -> FR-05-contracts
  #   src/egta/evidence/  | test/offline/evidence/  | test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts.py -> FR-01-evidence
  #   src/egta/risk_gate/ | test/offline/risk_gate/ -> FR-04-risk-gate
  #   src/egta/budget/ ... -> FR-02-budget
  # A single change may match several modules -> the loop checks EACH record.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  check-approval:
    name: check-approval (GATE-01)
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with: { python-version: "3.12" }
      - name: Check approval records for each changed module
        run: |
          base="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
          head="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
          git fetch --no-tags origin "$base" "$head" || true
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$head")
          if [ ! -f docs/req/requirements.yaml ]; then echo "::notice::requirements.yaml absent -- N/A"; exit 0; fi
          if ! echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(src|test)/'; then echo "::notice::no src/test change -- N/A"; exit 0; fi

          # Precise module detectors (evidence first, then contract/eval).
          hit_evidence=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/evidence/|^test/offline/evidence/|^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_fr05=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/contracts/|^src/egta/evaluation/|^test/offline/contracts/' | grep -v '^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_risk=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/risk_gate/|^test/offline/risk_gate/' || true)
          hit_budget=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/budget/' || true)

          fail=0; ran=0
          check() {
            mod="$1"; hit="$2"
            if [ -n "$hit" ]; then
              rec="docs/approvals/test-hash-${mod}.txt"
              if [ ! -f "$rec" ]; then echo "::notice::no record $rec -- N/A for $mod"; return; fi
              apbase=$(grep -E '^test_content_commit:' "$rec" | awk '{print $2}')
              echo "--- check-approval $mod (base=$apbase) ---"
              ran=$((ran+1))
              python tools/check_approval.py --repo . --record "$rec" \
                --implementation-base "$apbase" --implementation-head "$head" \
                --registry docs/req/requirements.yaml \
                --author "${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" || fail=1
            fi
          }
          check FR-01-evidence   "$hit_evidence"
          check FR-05-contracts  "$hit_fr05"
          check FR-04-risk-gate  "$hit_risk"
          check FR-02-budget     "$hit_budget"
          if [ "$ran" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::notice::no module record matched -- N/A"; fi
          exit $fail

@jianmin2004 (E) — 以下是 GATE-01 `check-approval` 作业在本 PR（#44，首个落在 `test/offline/evidence/` 的新测试 PR）上的失败根因与修复建议。CI 作业在 `/.github/workflows/`（E/D code-owned），我（A）没有改动。

## 现象

```
--- check-approval FR-01-evidence (base=511ef7d2f059) ---
RECORD_INVALID: approval record is missing or has malformed required fields
```

## 根因（本地逐行读 `tools/check_approval.py` + 复现）

1. **目录→单记录硬映射**（ci.yml:420/429）。`test/offline/evidence/` 的所有改动都路由到 `docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`：
   ```
   hit_evidence=... grep '^test/offline/evidence/|...'
   rec="docs/approvals/test-hash-${mod}.txt"   # mod=FR-01-evidence
   ```
   本 PR 新增 `test/offline/evidence/test_pack_precedence.py` → 命中 → 查 `FR-01-evidence`，**从不查**本 PR 真正的记录 `test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt`。

2. **旧记录不满足新 schema**。`_parse_record()`（check_approval.py:176-185）要求 `test_content_commit / reviewed_pr_head / approved_by / approved_at / requirement / files / aggregate` 全非空才返回 record，否则 `None` → `RECORD_INVALID`。
   `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`（#4 时代）实际字段：
   ```
   test_content_commit: 511ef7d2f059
   merge_commit: PENDING
   approved_by: D (@ZFebron491001) — PENDING
   approved_at: PENDING
   # 缺 reviewed_pr_head
   ```

3. **即便补齐也过不了**。我实验性补 `reviewed_pr_head` 后，checker 继续报：
   ```
   TEST_DRIFT: implementation changes a test path after approval
   ```
   原因：作业用 `implementation-base = record.test_content_commit = 511ef7d2f059`（ci.yml:431 `apbase`），从旧 base 到本 PR head 之间新增了 evidence 测试 → 任何后续 evidence 测试变更都被判 drift。

**结论**：`test/offline/evidence/` 被硬绑定到一个**过时、且 schema 不合规**的单一记录，导致 2026-11-22 之后任何 evidence 目录的 test PR 都无法通过 GATE-01。这与具体用例无关；`test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt` 本身格式是合规的。

## 修复建议（二选一，均在 E/D 范围）

**方案 A（推荐）— 让作业支持同目录多记录 / 按文件精确路由：**
- 把 evidence 目录的记录选择改为**按文件路由**：`test_pack_precedence.py` → `test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt`；其余 evidence 测试 → `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`（或新增的 evidence 汇总记录）。
- 或在 `check()` 里对同一 module 支持多记录列表，逐个校验，任一通过即可（类似 offline-tests 的 `RECORDS:` 求和思路）。

**方案 B — 让 `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt` 符合 checker：**
- 补 `reviewed_pr_head`（PR #4 的 reviewed head，需 D 确认；GitHub 上 #4 最终 APPROVED，head 为 `e5721c9c9cc8ce91d2a83bf86fc94370a8422562`）。
- 把 `approved_by`/`approved_at` 去掉 PENDING。
- 但 base 仍是老的 `511ef7d2f059`，**不能解决 TEST_DRIFT**；要解决需把该记录的 `test_content_commit` 指向更新的 evidence 冻结点并重算 37 个 per-file/aggregate hash——这等于**改动已合并的审批记录**，属 human-only，需 D 重新确认。

**注意**：方案 B 只是"修旧账"，无法覆盖未来新增 evidence 测试；**方案 A 才是可扩展的修法**。

## 后续

- 一旦门修好，我（A）在 #44 侧 rebase/重跑即可；#44 的 4 个用例、`test_content_commit 777f43e`、per-file `68be998b…`、aggregate `04fdffcb…`、trace 都无需改。
- 我不会绕过门去改受保护 CI 或已合并审批记录（AGENTS.md §5）。

@ZFebron491001 (D) 供参考：这是 gate/旧记录层的缺陷，非 #44 测试内容问题。
EOF

**结论**：`test/offline/evidence/` 被硬绑定到一个**过时、且 schema 不合规**的单一记录，导致 2026-11-22 之后任何 evidence 目录的 test PR 都无法通过 GATE-01。这与具体用例无关；`test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt` 本身格式是合规的。

## 修复建议（二选一，均在 E/D 范围）

**方案 A（推荐）— 让作业支持同目录多记录 / 按文件精确路由：**
- 把 evidence 目录的记录选择改为**按文件路由**：`test_pack_precedence.py` → `test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt`；其余 evidence 测试 → `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`（或新增的 evidence 汇总记录）。
- 或在 `check()` 里对同一 module 支持多记录列表，逐个校验，任一通过即可（类似 offline-tests 的 `RECORDS:` 求和思路）。

**方案 B — 让 `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt` 符合 checker：**

- 把 `approved_by`/`approved_at` 去掉 PENDING。
- 但 base 仍是老的 `511ef7d2f059`，**不能解决 TEST_DRIFT**；要解决需把该记录的 `test_content_commit` 指向更新的 evidence 冻结点并重算 37 个 per-file/aggregate hash——这等于**改动已合并的审批记录**，属 human-only，需 D 重新确认。

**注意**：方案 B 只是"修旧账"，无法覆盖未来新增 evidence 测试；**方案 A 才是可扩展的修法**。

给 D 和 E 的方案 A 修改要点（GATE-01 evidence 目录多记录/精确路由）

## 背景（一句话）
`test/offline/evidence/` 在 GATE-01 作业里被硬映射到单一、过时且 schema 不合规的 `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`，导致任何新增 evidence 测试的 PR 都无法通过（#44 首个暴露）。方案 A：改为**按文件精确路由 / 同目录多记录**。

## 需要改的文件（E/D 所有）
- `/ .github/workflows/ci.yml`（code-owned：E @jianmin2004 + D @ZFebron491001）——**唯一必改文件**。
- 不改 checker（`tools/check_approval.py`）本身，也不改任何已合并审批记录（方案 B 才涉及，本方案不碰）。

## 具体改动点

### 1. evidence 命中 → 按文件精确路由到对应记录
当前（ci.yml 约 420、429 行）：
```bash
hit_evidence=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/evidence/|^test/offline/evidence/|^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
...
rec="docs/approvals/test-hash-${mod}.txt"
```
改为：对 evidence 目录，按**文件 → 记录**映射，而不是一律 `test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`：
- `test/offline/evidence/test_pack_precedence.py` → `docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-01-precedence.txt`
- `test/offline/evidence/test_pack.py` → `docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-01-pack.txt`
- 其余 `test/offline/evidence/**`（time-policy、fixtures、conftest 等）→ `docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-01-evidence.txt`
- `src/egta/evidence/**`（实现改动）→ 不属于“测试内容”记录；应走实现 PR 的 GATE-01 语义（见下方“注意事项 4”）

实现方式建议：在 `check()` 前先算出 `changed` 里的 evidence 子集，逐个文件决定 `rec`，对每个 `(rec, files)` 调一次 `check_approval.py`（同一 module 允许多记录、逐个校验，全部匹配才 pass）。

### 2. 保持“同目录多记录逐个校验”的语义
- 一次 PR 可能同时改多个 evidence 记录对应的文件 → 对每条命中的记录都校验，全部通过才 pass（与既有“A single change may match several modules -> check EACH record”一致）。
- 每条记录的 `implementation-base` 继续用该记录自己的 `test_content_commit`（ci.yml:431 的 `apbase` 逻辑不变）。

### 3. 修正注释
- ci.yml 约 392-396 行注释把 `test/offline/evidence/` 整体归到 `FR-01-evidence`，改为说明“按文件路由到 `FR-01-pack` / `FR-01-precedence` / `FR-01-evidence` 三条记录”。

## 注意事项（避免踩坑）

1. **`FR-01-evidence` 自身仍是 RECORD_INVALID**：它的 `test_content_commit=511ef7d2f059` 且缺 `reviewed_pr_head`。方案 A 下，**只有当某 PR 改到它负责的文件时才会校验它**；#44 只改 `test_pack_precedence.py` → 只校验 `FR-01-precedence`，不会碰 `FR-01-evidence`。但一旦有人改 time-policy/fixtures，仍会撞 `FR-01-evidence` 的 RECORD_INVALID——这条“旧账”建议单独立一个记录修复 PR（由 D 确认，方案 B 的补字段部分），否则未来仍会红。
2. **`FR-01-precedence` 当前 `reviewed_pr_head`/`approved_by`/`approved_at` 为 PENDING**：按现有 checker 语义，spec PR 在**批准前**校验会 RECORD_INVALID。所以 #44 的次序是：D 审并 APPROVE → A 在记录里填 `reviewed_pr_head=<被批 head>`、`approved_by=D`、`approved_at=<review 时间>`（record-only 提交）→ 再跑 GATE-01 才应通过。请 D 确认这个“先批后填记录”的流程与 `test-hash-FR-01-pack.txt`(#42) 的做法一致。
3. **`FR-01-pack` 记录**（已 #42 完成，全字段齐全）作为参考范式；precedence 记录照它补齐即可。
4. **`src/egta/evidence/**` 实现改动**（#43）：GATE-01 记录绑定的是“测试内容 commit”。实现 PR 应以“从已批准 spec 的 merge commit 派生”来满足，而不是让 approval record 直接匹配实现 head。请 E/D 确认 gate 对**实现 PR**的预期（当前映射把 `src/egta/evidence/` 也纳入 `hit_evidence`，值得一并核对是否应只校验测试记录）。
5. **可扩展性**：方案 A 是白名单式文件→记录映射，未来新增 evidence 测试文件需要维护映射表；可在映射未命中时 fail-closed 并 `::notice::` 提示补映射，避免静默放行。

## 验证方式（修好后）
- 用 #44 重跑：应只出现 `--- check-approval FR-01-precedence (base=777f43e...) ---` 且 `OK`；不应再出现 `FR-01-evidence` 的 RECORD_INVALID。
- 另造一个只改 `test/offline/evidence/test_time_policy.py` 的 PR：应只校验 `FR-01-evidence`（该记录需先按方案 B 补字段，否则仍红——见注意事项 1）。
- 反向验证：故意让某 evidence 记录 hash 不符，确认对应文件被阻断。

## 分工
- E：改 ci.yml 路由 + 注释 + 反向测试。
- D：确认“先批后填记录”流程、确认 `FR-01-evidence` 旧账是否单独立修复 PR、复核路由表。
- A：门修好后 rebase/重跑 #44；补 precedence 记录的 reviewed/approved 字段（D 批准后）。

 name: CI
 
 on:
   push:
     branches: [main, 'v*']
   pull_request:
 
 concurrency:
   group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
   cancel-in-progress: true
 
 jobs:
   test:
     name: tests (py${{ matrix.python-version }}${{ matrix.tz && format(', {0}', matrix.tz) || '' }})
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     # Experimental interpreters (e.g. 3.14) are non-blocking.
     continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
         python-version: ["3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
         experimental: [false]
         # One run away from UTC, so a test that only passes in UTC fails here.
         # 3.14 is include-only and experimental (truly non-blocking) to avoid
         # false reds from a failing pip install / provider wheel gap.
         include:
           - python-version: "3.14"
             experimental: true
           - python-version: "3.12"
             tz: America/New_York
             experimental: false
     env:
       TZ: ${{ matrix.tz }}
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
         with:
           python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
       - name: Install (with dev extras)
         run: |
           python -m pip install --upgrade pip
           pip install -e ".[dev]"
       - name: Run test suite
         run: pytest -q
 
   smoke-install:
     name: clean-install smoke
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
         with:
           python-version: "3.12"
       - name: Fresh install (no dev extras) and import
         run: |
           python -m pip install --upgrade pip
           pip install .
           # Catches undeclared runtime deps (e.g. #994 python-dotenv): a bare
           # install must import the package and the CLI module.
           python -c "import tradingagents, cli.main; print('clean-install import OK')"
 
   lint:
     name: ruff (strict, full repo)
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
         with:
           python-version: "3.12"
       - name: Install ruff
         run: pip install "ruff>=0.16"
       - name: Lint the repository
         # The repo is fully clean under the strict select, so we lint everything
         # (generated results/ is excluded via pyproject extend-exclude).
         run: ruff check .
 
   # Offline spec suites, gated per-suite (A review: Block 1 + Block 2).
   #
   # Each suite independently detects its module directory so one unimplemented
   # module never reds another:
   #   contracts  ⇔ src/egta/contracts   (7 explicit FR-05 files; count read from
   #                docs/approvals/test-hash-FR-05-contracts.txt actual_cases, NOT
   #                hardcoded 199; not the whole directory -m spec, so other specs

   #   risk_gate  ⇔ src/egta/risk_gate   (test/offline/risk_gate by path, 139)
   #   budget     ⇔ src/egta/budget      (-m spec test/offline/budget; count read

   #
   # The gate runs pytest (not just --collect-only): the run's terminal summary
   # `passed` count must equal the expected number, and any skip/xfail/xpass/error
   # fails the gate. --collect-only is also checked for an extra consistency guard.
   #
   # GATE-06 (AI-use log) — why there is no status check here (D item 4): GATE-06 is

+tests need `docs/req/req-schema.json` from #15, so #31 builds on #15 and stays
+Draft until #15 merges.

+|---|---|

+| `test_cli_exit_one_on_failure` | CLI exit 1 when the registry fails |

+## Precedence and INV-02 reconciliation
+
+INV-02 freezes: a date-only/day value on the same UTC date is excluded with
+`FUTURE_DATA`, never `INVALID_TIME`, and `future_items_admitted == 0`. The cache
+rule does not violate INV-02:

+- A **future-dated cache** item is still **excluded** (never admitted), so the
+  INV-02 metric `future_items_admitted == 0` still holds. It is reported as

+  broader/stronger reason (off-line cache is unverifiable regardless of its
+  date), and it runs before the time filter. `STALE_DATA` and `FUTURE_DATA` are

+# Trace — FR-02 / INV-03 budget admission (governor-layer spec + gateway-pending list)
+
+Requirement-to-test trace for `test/offline/budget/test_admission.py`. This
+complements `test_reservation_holds.py` (the token-hold spec, PR #22).
+
+**Spec/test only. No `src/` implementation.** This file delivers the ONE governor
+test that can be written honestly today; the rest are listed as gateway-wiring
+acceptance items because no unified gateway entry exists yet.
+
+## Requirement basis
+
+- Day 1 (B, evening): reserve/settle with a concurrency lock.
+- Day 2 (B, morning): interruption / unknown-usage tests, reservation not released.
+- §5.1: `reserve(call_spec) -> Reservation | BudgetDenied`;
+  `settle(reservation_id, actual_usage_or_unknown) -> BudgetState`.
+- §5.3: reserve/settle persisted; unknown usage does not release; run-scope recovery.
+- §7.3 B3: no over-sell; all model calls pass through the governor; SDK implicit
+  retry disabled; do not record only post-call tokens.
+
+## Delivered test (governor layer)
+
+| Test | Chain | Expected | Simulation? |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `test_two_concurrent_calls_do_not_oversell_one_slot` | test starts 2 threads (barrier) → each calls `gov.reserve`; governor's lock decides | both entered; **exactly one `Reservation` and one `BudgetDenied`** | none: pure governor assertion; NO transport count is claimed |
+
+The barrier has a timeout and each worker join has a timeout, so a hung thread fails
+the test instead of blocking it.
+
+## Pending gateway wiring (NOT written as tests — would pass despite a real bypass)
+
+The following were drafted before but are removed because, without a unified gateway
+entry that lets the TESTED code trigger the send/fallback/admission, a budget bypass
+in the project's real path would still pass. There is no gateway/budget entry on
+`main` today. Each is an acceptance condition to implement once the gateway exists:
+
+1. **Tool binding does not spend budget; the bound call admits.**
+   - Must drive the real bound object (``bound.invoke``), not ``gov.reserve`` by hand.
+   - Acceptance: binding admits nothing; one bound call yields one admission.
+2. **Structured HTTP 400 → plain-text fallback admits again, via the real helper.**
+   - Must call the project's ``tradingagents.agents.structured.invoke_structured_or_freetext``
+     (with the gateway-wrapped model) so the tested code triggers the fallback and
+     the second admission itself.
+   - Acceptance: two separate admissions; process-local transport log
+     ``["structured","chat"]``.
+3. **Allowance 1 + structured 400 → fallback denied, transport total 1.**
+   - Same real-helper path; the second admission must be refused by the governor.
+   - Acceptance: first `Reservation`; fallback `BudgetDenied`; transport total 1.
+4. **Same business entry under ample and zero budget (gateway wiring).**
+   - Must call the real entry (app/runner/gateway), NOT a test-built `_run_entry_once`.
+   - Acceptance: ample → admitted + 1 send; zero → entry runs, admitted result is
+     denied, transport 0; final run status per the frozen contract (see Q1).
+5. **Sent, then interrupted before usage (gateway wiring) — token is the only tight
+   axis.**
+   - Setup: first call reserves **1000/1000 tokens** (calls and cost have spare room).
+   - Behavior: via the tested entry, the first request leaves; the mock/real transport
+     records it then the call times out **before** usage is confirmed; then a SECOND
+     request for **1 token** through the SAME entry.
+   - Acceptance: the second request is refused (`BudgetDenied`); the reservation is
+     still held (token not refunded — call/cost spare room means the denial cannot be
+     explained by those axes); transport total stays 1.
+   - Why it needs wiring: the timeout must reach the budget logic through a public
+     entry that owns reserve/settle. A governor-only test cannot route a client
+     timeout back into the reservation, and re-inventing a gateway in the test would
+     hide a real bypass. This is the "interruption" complement to #22's outstanding
+     reservation (which never sends) and is distinct from cross-process recovery.
+
+Observed client behavior (for the future item 5): a real ``NormalizedChatOpenAI`` over
+``httpx.MockTransport`` that records then raises ``httpx.ReadTimeout`` surfaces
+``langchain_openai.chat_models.base.OpenAITimeoutError`` (a subclass of
+``openai.APITimeoutError``) to the caller, with the request having left once. Note:
+``httpx.MockTransport`` records an IN-PROCESS received request; it is not proof of a
+real socket send.
+
+## Reuse vs. #22 bytes (avoid duplicate delivery)
+
+Compared against #22 fixed commit `efa4bbe1d4aa5b3c0e9530e95eee58b637f92adc`:
+
+- `test/offline/budget/conftest.py`: **byte-identical** to #22. After #22 merges, take
+  it from #22; do not re-deliver.
+- `test/offline/budget/fakes.py`: byte-identical #22 prefix + a small admission
+  suffix (`ONE_CALL_LIMITS`, `ONE_CALL_ASK`). After #22 merges, keep only the suffix.
+- `test_reservation_holds.py`: untouched; #22's three cases and semantics are preserved.
+- `test_admission.py`: this branch's new file (1 test).
+
+## Evidence and baseline
+
+History (earlier draft worktree `spec/B-budget-admission`, HEAD `6830926`, draft
+untracked): the isolated draft was authored and first run there; results in the
+"RED status" below are re-run in the #22 worktree described next.
+
+Final run (this commit's worktree — the #22 branch, `spec/B-budget-reservation-v2`):
+
+- Worktree HEAD at run time: `efa4bbe1d4aa5b3c0e9530e95eee58b637f92adc`.
+- Verification ran on HEAD `efa4bbe` with the local, uncommitted admission increment.
+- `origin/main` queried during this session: `141547a87f6781abf85ee51fba33898d7c0db671`
+  (after the #21 merge). The increment was **not** separately re-run on a `141547a`
+  checkout; it ran on the `efa4bbe` worktree above.
+- `httpx.MockTransport` records in-process received requests only; it is not proof
+  of a real socket send.
+
+## RED status on this branch (real, #22 worktree at `efa4bbe` + increment)
+
+The explicit budget spec now selects all four tests (three reservation from #22 +
+the one admission test):
+
+- `python -m ruff check .` → All checks passed (exit 0)
+- `python -m py_compile test/offline/budget/*.py` → exit 0
+- `python -m pytest -m spec test/offline/budget/ --collect-only -q` → **4 collected**
+- `python -m pytest -m spec test/offline/budget/ -q --tb=line` → **4 collected,
+  4 executed, 4 failed**, exit 1; every failure at `conftest.py:64`
+  (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'egta.budget'`); **business assertions
+  executed: 0**. Not a collection error, not "0 executed".
+
+## Open questions for E / C
+
+For **E**: (1) final run status when budget is exhausted at the entry
+(`INCOMPLETE` vs a dedicated governor status); (2) whether tool binding lives on the
+governor or a gateway/adapter; (3) structured + fallback = two separate admissions
+(this spec's expectation, consistent with the client sending twice).
+
+For **C**: (4) the fake gateway interface: how a bound-tool call and a structured
+fallback route through the single admission point, and how the gateway surfaces
+"interrupted after send, before usage" to the budget layer. This is what turns items
+1–5 above into real tests.
+
+## Not covered here
+
+- Cross-process durable restart recovery.
+- SDK retry accounting (retries must not double-charge or bypass reserve).
+- End-to-end `propagate`/CLI run status.

+# Trace — FR-02 / INV-03 budget reservation (test-first spec)
+
+Requirement-to-test trace for `test/offline/budget/test_reservation_holds.py`.
+Focus: the 11/21 independent task "an interruption or an unknown-usage outcome must
+not release a budget reservation early" (TimeLine Day 2 B; plan §7.3 B3).
+
+**Spec/test only. No `src/` implementation.** The `governor_factory` fixture always
+returns a factory; a behavioural test fails red when it CALLS that factory (the lazy
+`from egta.budget import BudgetGovernor` inside it), so each case fails individually
+and they are not skipped.
+
+## Requirement basis
+
+- §7.3 B3: "完成中断与未知 usage 测试，证明预留不会提前释放".
+- §5.3 Budget ledger: "每次 reserve/settle 持久化；未知 usage 不释放预留".
+- §7.3 delivery: "不得仅记录调用后的 token"; INV-03 "每次外部模型调用先获预算预留".
+- Plan line 131: "usage 不明时保留预留额，不把额度提前返还".
+- Day 2 gate G1: 正常 / 拒绝 / 超预算 three paths; this PR covers the denial stay-held
+  path for unknown usage.
+
+## Frozen entry points (§5.1)
+
+    BudgetGovernor.reserve(call_spec) -> Reservation | BudgetDenied
+    BudgetGovernor.settle(reservation_id, actual_usage_or_unknown) -> BudgetState
+
+These two signatures are frozen by the plan. Everything else used by the tests
+(`call_spec` shape, `Reservation` attributes, `BudgetState` shape, how "unknown"
+is encoded, persistence backend) is NOT frozen; see "Open interface questions".
+
+## Coverage
+
+All three tests are governor-layer only (no HTTP, no fake governor). A refusal is
+asserted ONLY as the contract type `BudgetDenied` (never `None` or a truthiness
+guess); a grant is asserted POSITIVELY as the contract type `Reservation` (so
+`None` or a wrong value cannot pass as a grant either).
+
+| # | Test | Requirement | Scenario | Pass condition |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | `test_unknown_usage_holds_token_reservation_denies_one_token_followup` | FR-02, INV-03, §5.3 | Reserve the whole token axis; `settle(id, unknown)`; then ask for **1 token** | second `reserve` returns `BudgetDenied` (the held 1000 tokens were NOT refunded on unknown usage; even 1 token is denied) |
+| 2 | `test_outstanding_unsettled_reservation_denies_one_token_followup` | FR-02, INV-03, §5.3 | Reserve the whole token axis; do NOT settle; ask for **1 token** | second `reserve` returns `BudgetDenied` (an outstanding reservation is not reusable) |
+| 3 | `test_known_low_usage_releases_tokens_grants_one_token_followup` | FR-02, INV-03 | SAME limits; `settle(id, known 100 tokens)`; then ask for **1 token** | second `reserve` returns a `Reservation` (positive type assert): 900 free >= 1, proving the governor CAN grant when balance exists |
+
+### Why only the token axis is tight (hand-check)
+
+Limits (identical for every test): `max_total_tokens=1000`, `max_calls=5`,
+`max_cost_usd=1.00`.
+
+| Test | First call asks | Settled as | Tokens free after settle | Follow-up asks | Fits? | Expected |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 (unknown) | 1000 tok, 1 call, $0.01 | unknown (held) | 1000 held, **0 free** | **1 tok** | no | **BudgetDenied** |
+| 2 (outstanding) | 1000 tok, 1 call, $0.01 | not settled | 1000 held, **0 free** | **1 tok** | no | **BudgetDenied** |
+| 3 (control) | 1000 tok, 1 call, $0.01 | known 100 tok | 900 free | **1 tok** | yes | **Reservation** |
+
+All three use the SAME limits, the SAME first `FULL_TOKEN_CALL` (1000 tokens), and
+the SAME `FOLLOWUP_ONE_TOKEN` (1 token); they differ ONLY in the settle condition.
+Calls (1/5) and cost ($0.01/$1.00) have spare room, so the follow-up is never denied
+merely because call count or cost ran out. Because the follow-up is only 1 token,
+a governor that refunds even a few tokens early (on unknown usage, or before settle)
+would GRANT it, so tests 1 and 2 catch a partial early refund — not just a full one.
+Test 3 shows the same 1-token follow-up IS granted once 900 tokens are truly free,
+so the denials are about the held tokens, not a governor that refuses everything.
+
+## RED status on this branch (real)
+
+The `egta` namespace exists via `src/egta/evidence`, so the error is specifically
+the missing budget module.
+
+Verified earlier on baseline `69da0e464b562d54bcfdec5beb84bd98bbf8a943`
+(`origin/main` before the D-only fast-forward; branch `spec/B-budget-reservation-v2`),
+and re-verified on the current baseline **`0ab1c823b62f6cc75c96463f46a72a81da56ed9b`**
+(`origin/main` after D's two records; this branch fast-forwarded to it, keeping all
+five working files). Same results on both:
+
+- `python -m ruff check .` → All checks passed (exit 0)
+- `python -m py_compile test/offline/budget/*.py` → exit 0
+- `python -m pytest -m spec test/offline/budget/ --collect-only -q` → **3 collected**
+  (the three tests are selected by `-m spec`), exit 0
+- `python -m pytest -m spec test/offline/budget/ -q --tb=line` → **3 collected,
+  3 executed, 3 failed**, exit 1; first error `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named
+  'egta.budget'` at `conftest.py:64` (the lazy `from egta.budget import BudgetGovernor`
+  reached when a test calls `governor_factory()`). Business assertions executed: **0**
+  (no governor exists). This is NOT a collection error and NOT "0 executed".
+- Default suite is unaffected: `python -m pytest -q` → `1412 passed, 1 skipped,
+  1 deselected, 24 warnings, 100 subtests passed` (the budget spec is excluded by
+  `-m "not integration and not spec"`).
+
+## What the tests deliberately do NOT do
+
+- No governor implementation, no fake governor, no fabricated persisted state.
+- No freeze of `call_spec`/`Reservation`/`BudgetState` shapes.
+- No claim that integrity/business behaviour passes; they assert the stay-held rule
+  once the governor exists.
+
+## Candidate interface (needs B/E review)
+
+The refusal RESULT is frozen by plan §5.1: `reserve(...) -> Reservation |
+BudgetDenied`. The tests import `BudgetDenied` and `Reservation` from
+`egta.budget`; that public import path (module location / export name) is a
+candidate, not yet frozen. The other items below are a MINIMAL proposal the tests
+currently assume; each is a single choice rather than a guess-with-fallbacks.
+
+- **Public import path:** `from egta.budget import BudgetGovernor, Reservation,
+  BudgetDenied`. Candidate (the result TYPES above are frozen; their module/export
+  path is what needs confirming).
+- **Construction:** `BudgetGovernor(limits=<dict>, db_path=<Path>)`. Candidate.
+- **`call_spec`:** a dict with `max_tokens`, `max_calls`, `max_cost_usd`. Candidate.
+- **`limits` keys:** `max_total_tokens`, `max_calls`, `max_cost_usd`. Candidate.
+- **Unknown usage:** `settle(rid, actual_usage_or_unknown=None)` — `None` = unknown.
+  Candidate; alternatives are a dedicated enum member or a separate
+  `settle_unknown(rid)`.
+- **Known usage:** `settle(rid, actual_usage_or_unknown={...})`. Candidate. NFR-01 is
+  a TRIPLE constraint (tokens / cost / calls), so when all three actual amounts are
+  known, pass the full triplet:
+  `settle(rid, {"tokens": N, "cost_usd": D, "calls": C})`. A PARTIAL dict settles only
+  the axes it names; every unnamed axis stays on its original reservation (treated as
+  not yet known, so retained — never silently reset). Example:
+  `settle(rid, {"tokens": 100})` settles only the token axis (releasing 900 of the
+  1000 held there), while the cost and calls reservations remain held. Money keeps the
+  current string decimal form (e.g. `"0.01"`, consistent with `max_cost_usd`).
+- **Reservation id:** `Reservation.reservation_id`. Candidate.
+
+## Not covered here (future)
+
+- **Real-gateway send-then-interrupt:** a request that actually leaves, times out
+  after send, and whose follow-up shows ZERO new transport requests. Deferred to the
+  gateway integration test; a governor-only test cannot prove transport behaviour.
+- **Durable restart recovery:** "run 内恢复" surviving process restart.
+- **Concurrency / no over-sell** under parallel reserve (B2 case).
+- **SDK retry accounting:** retries must not double-charge or bypass reserve.
+- **End-to-end `propagate`/CLI** proving all model calls pass through the governor.

+
+
+def recompute_evidence_hash(pack: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_hex(evidence_fields(pack))
+
+
+def payload_hash(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """SHA-256 over contracts.audit's canonical RunEvent JSON.
+
+    ``contracts.audit.recompute_payload_hash`` uses Pydantic
+    ``model_dump(mode="json")`` plus ``json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True,
+    separators=(",", ":"))``. UTC datetimes therefore render with a trailing
+    ``Z``. Keep this byte-compatible; otherwise an outbox event that is valid
+    for the risk gate is rejected by E's verify_payload/replay.
+    """
+    canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
